# Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

> Vanilla Breeze is an HTML-first component system. Native HTML elements are styled with no classes, layout comes from `data-layout` attributes, and custom elements add behaviour on top of markup that already works without JavaScript. There is no build step.

## Load it

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/vanilla-breeze@0.7.4/dist/cdn/vanilla-breeze.css">
<script type="module" src="https://unpkg.com/vanilla-breeze@0.7.4/dist/cdn/vanilla-breeze.js"></script>
```

With npm: `npm install vanilla-breeze`, then `import 'vanilla-breeze/css'` and `import 'vanilla-breeze'`.

## Rules for writing markup

1. **Write complete native HTML first.** Use `header`, `nav`, `main`, `article`, `section`, `aside`, `footer`, headings in order, `label` with every form control. The page must be readable and usable before any Vanilla Breeze element or script is involved.
2. **Do not use `<div>` or `<span>` for layout.** Put `data-layout` on a semantic element, or use a `layout-*` element where no semantic element fits. Layout values: `center`, `cluster`, `columns`, `cover`, `grid`, `media`, `page-stack`, `prose`, `reel`, `regions`, `sidebar`, `sidebar-left`, `sidebar-right`, `split`, `stack`, `switcher`.
3. **Do not write inline styles or utility classes.** Native elements are already styled. Spacing, alignment and variants are set with the `data-*` attributes each layout or component documents.
4. **Attributes carry state and configuration; classes do not.** Use the `data-*` attributes listed for a component, with the values listed. Never invent a tag, an attribute or a value: if it is not in these files, it does not exist.
5. **Custom elements wrap working markup.** A component's children are its fallback: `<tab-set>` and `<accordion-wc>` wrap `<details>`, `<form-field>` wraps a `label` and an `input`. Never leave a component empty and expect script to fill it.
6. **Use `<form-field>` for form controls and `<icon-wc name="…">` for icons**, not hand-written wrappers or inline SVG.
7. **Theme with attributes on `<html>`**: `data-theme="name"` selects a theme, `data-mode="light"` or `"dark"` forces a colour scheme. Colours, spacing and type come from design tokens (CSS custom properties); do not hard-code values.

## Check your work

Run the checker on every file you write or change, and fix everything it reports before you finish:

```bash
npx vb-check page.html
```

It needs `html-validate` installed beside `vanilla-breeze` (`npm install --save-dev html-validate`). It lists each problem with file, line, rule and the fix: unknown elements, attribute values that do not exist, `<div>` used for layout, inline styles, layout attributes no layout reads. An error means the markup is wrong; a warning asks you to confirm an attribute or class is intentional.

## How to use these files

Start from the component list below and open the file for each component you plan to use; it has the allowed attributes, values, child structure, events and keyboard behaviour, plus an example. `attributes.md` lists the attributes that work on any element, `native-elements.md` the native elements with dedicated documentation, and `llms-full.txt` holds everything in one file.

## Layouts

- [<layout-badge>](components/layout-badge.md): Small inline status or count badge.
- [<layout-canvas>](components/layout-canvas.md): Elevated content surface (a panel with radius, shadow and a 1px edge: a hairline on a plain page, transparent under data-backdrop, CanvasText in forced colours).
- [<layout-card>](components/layout-card.md): Card surface.
- [<layout-center>](components/layout-center.md): Horizontally centered, max-width-constrained container with side gutters.
- [<layout-cluster>](components/layout-cluster.md): Horizontal wrapping flex row for groups of short items — tags, buttons, metadata.
- [<layout-columns>](components/layout-columns.md): Multi-column text flow with a readable measure, vertical rhythm (between direct children), column rules and break hygiene.
- [<layout-cover>](components/layout-cover.md): Full-height (min-block-size) flex column that vertically centers a principal element (data-layout-principal; a sole child auto-centers), with header/footer or cover-top/-bottom children pinned to the edges.
- [<layout-grid>](components/layout-grid.md): Auto-fit responsive grid: as many columns as fit the minimum width, then wrap.
- [<layout-imposter>](components/layout-imposter.md): Positioned overlay centred over (or pinned to an edge or corner of) its containing block, logically (mirrored in RTL).
- [<layout-reel>](components/layout-reel.md): Horizontal scrolling strip with proximity snap points, an optional scrollbar and edge hints.
- [<layout-sidebar>](components/layout-sidebar.md): Two-column layout: a fixed-basis sidebar beside a flexible content column that wraps below it when there is no room.
- [<layout-stack>](components/layout-stack.md): Vertical flex stack with a consistent gap between children.
- [<layout-switcher>](components/layout-switcher.md): Flex row that switches to a column once the switcher's own width drops below the threshold (a flex-basis formula, no media or container query).
- [<layout-text>](components/layout-text.md): Long-form reading container: a readable measure plus vertical rhythm between direct children.

## Web components (need the script; children are the fallback)

- [<accordion-wc>](components/accordion-wc.md): Accordion built on native details/summary with exclusive mode and transitions
- [<activity-feed>](components/activity-feed.md): WAI-ARIA Feed timeline of user actions.
- [<ai-chat>](components/ai-chat.md): On-device chat via Chrome's LanguageModel API.
- [<ai-summary>](components/ai-summary.md): Summarise wrapped content via Chrome's Summarizer API, with optional inline endpoint fallback and external deep-link fallback.
- [<analytics-panel>](components/analytics-panel.md): Visitor-facing view of what analytics is doing on this page: whether it runs, why it is off, and which fields an event carries, with a Pause / Resume control.
- [<audio-player>](components/audio-player.md): Platform audio player web component
- [<audio-visualizer>](components/audio-visualizer.md): Canvas-based audio visualization companion
- [<author-index>](components/author-index.md): Author-grouped view of site content.
- [<brand-mark>](components/brand-mark.md): Brand/logo display.
- [<bread-crumb>](components/bread-crumb.md): Hierarchical navigation trail.
- [<calendar-wc>](components/calendar-wc.md): Standalone calendar display with rich cell content
- [<card-list>](components/card-list.md): Template-based list rendering with safe data binding: property paths only, sanitized HTML, and URL-checked attribute bindings
- [<carousel-wc>](components/carousel-wc.md): Scrolling carousel with autoplay, looping, indicators, and view transitions
- [<change-set>](components/change-set.md): Interactive change tracking group: a caption from author/datetime plus Tracking / Final / Original toggles over its <ins> / <del> descendants
- [<chart-wc>](components/chart-wc.md): SVG chart component with progressive enhancement: semantic table → CSS chart → SVG chart.
- [<chat-input>](components/chat-input.md): Form-associated chat input with auto-growing textarea; submits its form, or fires chat-input:send when standalone
- [<chat-window>](components/chat-window.md): Light DOM orchestrator for chat UI
- [<color-picker>](components/color-picker.md): Form-associated color picker with saturation/lightness area, hue slider, HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH inputs, preset swatches, Copy and EyeDropper
- [<combo-box>](components/combo-box.md): Autocomplete combobox with filtering, keyboard navigation, and native form association
- [<command-group>](components/command-group.md): A labelled group of <command-item> elements inside a <command-palette>.
- [<command-item>](components/command-item.md): One command inside a <command-palette>, optionally within a <command-group>.
- [<command-palette>](components/command-palette.md): Command palette / Cmd+K launcher (modal dialog, combobox + listbox)
- [<comment-box>](components/comment-box.md): Form-associated comment form composing <markdown-editor> + Submit / Cancel buttons.
- [<comment-thread>](components/comment-thread.md): Persistent threaded-discussion container.
- [<comment-wc>](components/comment-wc.md): EXPERIMENTAL / STUB: inline "Add comment" action for selection-menu.
- [<compare-surface>](components/compare-surface.md): Before/after comparison slider: two overlaid children with a draggable, keyboard-operable divider (side by side without JS)
- [<consent-banner>](components/consent-banner.md): Cookie consent banner with granular category controls and persistence
- [<content-lens>](components/content-lens.md): Universal switchable host for VB lens components; JS API: activeLens (read-only), setLens(name)
- [<content-swap>](components/content-swap.md): Two-face content toggle with accessible state management.
- [<context-menu>](components/context-menu.md): Right-click (and Shift+F10 / ContextMenu key) menu with keyboard navigation and shortcut bindings
- [<data-table>](components/data-table.md): Enhanced HTML table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row expansion, and selection
- [<date-picker>](components/date-picker.md): Form-associated calendar date picker with combobox text entry
- [<day-view>](components/day-view.md): Hour-grid schedule for a single day, using hour-view and calendar-event children
- [<diagram-wc>](components/diagram-wc.md): Declarative diagram renderer — wraps Mermaid (v1) with VB token-driven theming, lazy load, and HTML-first authoring via fenced code blocks
- [<drag-surface>](components/drag-surface.md): Accessible drag-and-drop reorder surface with keyboard reorder, optional single-pointer move controls, live announcements and cross-surface transfer
- [<drop-down>](components/drop-down.md): Accessible dropdown: an APG menu button for actions, or (with hover) an APG disclosure for navigation links
- [<emoji-picker>](components/emoji-picker.md): Accessible emoji picker with search, a category toolbar, a listbox of emoji, and undoable insertion into a target field
- [<flow-diagram>](components/flow-diagram.md): User flow and sequence visualization — progressively enhances an ol into a labelled figure holding a nested list drawn as a connected node graph with actions, decisions, and branches
- [<foot-note>](components/foot-note.md): One footnote, written inline where its reference mark belongs.
- [<foot-notes>](components/foot-notes.md): Progressive enhancement for footnotes: collects the <foot-note> elements that precede it into a labelled doc-endnotes list (or margin sidenotes), with doc-noteref references, doc-backlink return links, shared notes for repeat citations and a hover/focus preview.
- [<form-field>](components/form-field.md): Accessible form field: binds its control (native or form-associated custom element), times validation, shows hint/error outputs and wires aria-describedby / aria-invalid
- [<geo-map>](components/geo-map.md): A zero-dependency map component using OpenStreetMap / CARTO raster tiles or your own tile proxy, with a lazy-loaded interactive pan / zoom mode.
- [<glossary-index>](components/glossary-index.md): Interactive glossary with search filtering and scroll-spy letter tracking; copyable term permalinks are opt-in
- [<glossary-wc>](components/glossary-wc.md): Searchable, categorized, cross-linked glossary that progressively enhances a definition list
- [<heading-links>](components/heading-links.md): Add permalink anchors to headings; activating one follows the fragment and copies the section URL
- [<highlight-wc>](components/highlight-wc.md): Text highlighting with localStorage persistence.
- [<icon-wc>](components/icon-wc.md): Inline SVG icon: fetches one sanitized SVG file per icon from <base-path>/<set>/<name>.svg, sized by preset and labelled for assistive tech
- [<image-gallery>](components/image-gallery.md): Thumbnail grid with lightbox viewer.
- [<image-map>](components/image-map.md): Responsive image map: <map-area> children define percentage-coordinate hotspots (rect, circle, poly) over a child <img>, with an SVG hit-testing overlay, keyboard-focusable anchors, and rich HTML tooltips.
- [<include-file>](components/include-file.md): Fetch a same-origin HTML fragment, sanitize it, and insert it into the page
- [<markdown-editor>](components/markdown-editor.md): Side-by-side markdown editor with live preview.
- [<markdown-viewer>](components/markdown-viewer.md): Render markdown content with progressive enhancement.
- [<nav-bar>](components/nav-bar.md): Top-level site/app navigation primitive.
- [<note-wc>](components/note-wc.md): Private reader notes on highlights: a note action inside selection-menu, a page-level button with for="id", and the note panel itself.
- [<notification-wc>](components/notification-wc.md): Dual-mode notification component: dismissible banner or bell-icon panel with history + read tracking.
- [<page-info>](components/page-info.md): Document provenance disclosure panel
- [<page-stats>](components/page-stats.md): Lightweight reading statistics
- [<page-toc>](components/page-toc.md): Table of contents with scroll-spy
- [<page-tools>](components/page-tools.md): Configurable toolbar for page-level utilities
- [<page-tour>](components/page-tour.md): Progressive-enhancement guided tour.
- [<pager-wc>](components/pager-wc.md): Standalone pagination controls element targeting any [data-paged] container.
- [<poll-wc>](components/poll-wc.md): Voting + live results.
- [<pop-over>](components/pop-over.md): General-purpose popover container with CSS Anchor Positioning.
- [<popularity-index>](components/popularity-index.md): Aggregated most-visited lens.
- [<print-page>](components/print-page.md): Print button with optional raw-mode toggle
- [<progress-tracker>](components/progress-tracker.md): Multi-step progress bar for wizards / checkout / onboarding flows.
- [<qr-code>](components/qr-code.md): QR code generator: black-on-white canvas with quiet zone, author children kept as the caption
- [<reaction-bar>](components/reaction-bar.md): GitHub-style emoji reaction picker.
- [<reader-view>](components/reader-view.md): Immersive reading shell with scroll and paged modes.

- [<recently-visited>](components/recently-visited.md): Device-local reader history lens (localStorage, never sent or aggregated).

- [<status-wc>](components/status-wc.md): Visual state indicator.
- [<stepper-wc>](components/stepper-wc.md): Stepper for values <input type="number"> + data-stepper cannot reach: formatted units, currency, time, token-snap scales, discrete enums.

## Reference

- [Attributes](attributes.md): Attributes that work on any element, grouped by purpose
- [Native elements](native-elements.md): Native elements with dedicated documentation
- [Everything in one file](llms-full.txt): This index, every component file and both reference files

## Guides

- [Quick Start](https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/quick-start/): One HTML file, ten minutes. Write plain semantic HTML, then add Vanilla Breeze one optional layer at a time: styles, layout attributes, components and a theme. No utility classes, no wrapper divs, no build step.
- [Principles](https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/principles/): What Vanilla Breeze commits to: HTML as the atom, one grammar across HTML, CSS and JavaScript, optional layers, themeable presentation, minimal execution, overridable defaults and the web for all.
- [Semantic Layouts](https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/semantic-layouts/): Put a layout on the element you already have with data-layout, and skip the wrapper. The rules are the same as the layout elements, with a few differences that come from the host element.
- [Layouts Overview](https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/layouts/): How Vanilla Breeze arranges things on a page: a small set of layouts that each do one job, respond to the space they are given and nest inside each other.
- [Themes](https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/themes/): Color themes and personality themes for Vanilla Breeze. Customize your design with a single attribute.
- [Design Tokens](https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/tokens/): CSS custom properties for colors, spacing, typography, borders, shadows, and motion. Consistent values for your entire design system.
- [Accessibility Overview](https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/accessibility/): What Vanilla Breeze does for accessibility, what you still provide, the standard it aims at and the checks that hold it there.

---

# <accordion-wc>

Accordion built on native details/summary with exclusive mode and transitions

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/accordion/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<accordion-wc>
  <details>
    <summary>What is Vanilla Breeze?</summary>
    <p>Vanilla Breeze is a layered HTML component system...</p>
  </details>
  <details>
    <summary>How does progressive enhancement work?</summary>
    <p>Components work without JavaScript first...</p>
  </details>
</accordion-wc>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `single` | boolean |  | Only allow one panel open at a time |
| `bordered` | boolean |  | Add borders between panels |
| `flush` | boolean |  | Remove inline padding on summaries and panels so content aligns with surrounding text |
| `compact` | boolean |  | Reduce spacing |
| `indicator` | `plus-minus`, `none`, `custom` |  | Expand/collapse indicator style |
| `transition` | `fade`, `slide`, `scale` |  | Panel transition animation |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<details>` | One per accordion panel — native disclosure element |
| `<summary>` | Panel heading inside each <details> |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accordion-wc:toggle` | `{ index, open }` | Fired when a panel opens or closes |
| `accordion-wc:panels-changed` | `{ panels, source: 'property' }` | Fired after the panels property rebuilds the accordion |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open(index)` | Open the panel at index (out-of-range indexes are ignored) |
| `close(index)` | Close the panel at index |
| `toggle(index)` | Toggle the panel at index |
| `openAll()` | Open every panel (no-op in single mode) |
| `closeAll()` | Close every panel |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `panels` | `Array<{ id?, summary, content, open? }>` | Get the panel set as data, or assign one to rebuild the accordion |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Accordion
- You provide: A <details> element with a <summary> for each panel; panels are region landmarks only when there are six or fewer
- The component manages: `role="region"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-labelledby`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Open or close the panel | Native behaviour of <summary> |
| `ArrowDown` | Move focus to the next panel header, wrapping to the first | Focus on a panel header |
| `ArrowUp` | Move focus to the previous panel header, wrapping to the last | Focus on a panel header |
| `Home` | Move focus to the first panel header | Focus on a panel header |
| `End` | Move focus to the last panel header | Focus on a panel header |

---

# <activity-feed>

WAI-ARIA Feed timeline of user actions. Author renders <article data-activity> children timestamped with data-time or an authored <time datetime> child; component decorates with relative-time badges, optional date grouping, optional infinite-scroll sentinel (aria-busy + done() handshake), and per-entry avatar / icon left-rail.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/activity-feed/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<activity-feed aria-label="Recent activity">
  <article data-activity data-time="2026-05-14T10:00:00Z">
    <a href="/users/ada">Ada</a> commented on <a href="/issues/482">issue #482</a>
  </article>
  <article data-activity data-time="2026-05-14T09:30:00Z">
    <a href="/users/bob">Bob</a> opened <a href="/issues/485">issue #485</a>
  </article>
</activity-feed>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | string |  | Region label (default "Recent activity") |
| `data-group` | string |  | none (default) \| day \| week — date headings between entries |
| `data-infinite` | boolean |  | Adds an IntersectionObserver sentinel; emits activity-feed:load-more when reached and sets aria-setsize="-1" on entries. Remove the attribute to end the feed (sentinel removed, real aria-setsize, aria-busy cleared). |
| `data-empty-text` | string |  | Text shown when the feed has zero entries (default "No recent activity") |
| `role` |  |  | Managed: "feed" while the feed has entries, "group" while empty (so the empty-state text is a valid child). An author-set role other than feed/group is left alone. |
| `aria-busy` | string |  | Managed: "true" from activity-feed:load-more until detail.done() is called, new entries arrive, or data-infinite is removed. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-activity` | article | boolean |  | Marks an article as a feed entry |
| `data-time` | article | string |  | ISO-8601 timestamp; renders as relative time. Alternatively author a direct-child <time datetime> (works without JS and is upgraded in place); data-time wins if both are present |
| `data-activity-avatar` | article | string |  | Avatar URL — renders <user-avatar> in the left rail |
| `data-activity-icon` | article | string |  | icon-wc name — renders <icon-wc> in the left rail (alternative to avatar) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `activity-feed:load-more` | `{ done: () => void }` | Fires when the infinite-scroll sentinel comes into view (at most one outstanding request). detail.done() ends the busy state and re-arms the sentinel; appending entries or removing data-infinite also ends it. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addEntry` | `(data, opts?) => HTMLElement` | Append (or prepend) an entry from data |
| `removeEntry` | `(entry) => void` | Remove a single entry element |
| `clear` | `() => void` | Remove every entry |
| `entries` | `HTMLElement[]` | Snapshot array of the current entry elements (a new array on each read, not live) |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Read-only. True while a load-more is outstanding (mirrors aria-busy) |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Feed
- You provide: An <article data-activity> for each entry, and an aria-label on the feed when the default "Recent activity" does not describe it
- The component manages: `role="feed"`, `role="group"`, `aria-label`, `aria-busy`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-posinset`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-hidden`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PageDown` | Move focus to the next entry | Focus on or inside an entry |
| `PageUp` | Move focus to the previous entry | Focus on or inside an entry |
| `Ctrl+End` | Move focus to the first focusable element after the feed | Focus on or inside an entry |
| `Ctrl+Home` | Move focus to the last focusable element before the feed | Focus on or inside an entry |

---

# <ai-chat>

On-device chat via Chrome's LanguageModel API. Optionally page-aware via context selector. Inline endpoint and external deep-link fallbacks. Conforms to admin/specs/ai-page-tools-v1.md.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/ai-chat/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<ai-chat
    context="#article"
    context-label="this article"
    placeholder="Ask about this page…">
  <template data-role="system">
    Answer using only the page content provided.
    If the answer isn't there, say so plainly.
  </template>
  <template data-role="starters">
    Summarize the article in 3 bullets.
    What problem does the author identify?
  </template>
</ai-chat>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | string |  | CSS selector of a page region whose text is folded into the system prompt. Empty = general chat. |
| `context-label` | string |  | Human-friendly label for the context region (shown in the ribbon and used in the system prompt header). |
| `system` | string |  | System-prompt prefix. May also be supplied via <template data-role='system'>; attribute wins. |
| `placeholder` | string | `Type a message…` | Textarea placeholder text. Reactive via attributeChangedCallback. |
| `endpoint` | string |  | Inline-fallback HTTP URL (POST JSON, streamed text/plain or one-shot application/json). Sends prior turns as messages[] (admin/specs/ai-page-tools-v1.md §C, v1.1). |
| `fallback-url` | string |  | Deep-link URL template. Tokens: {prompt} {url} {title} {content}. {content} is the context region's text, capped at 1500 characters (empty without a context attribute). Provider-neutral. |
| `fallback-label` | string |  | Override the deep-link option label in the chat-window provider select. |
| `fallback-prompt` | string | `Help me explore this article: {title} ({url})` | Override the {prompt} string substituted into fallback-url. |
| `data-state` | `checking`, `ready`, `downloading`, `streaming`, `error`, `unavailable` |  | Lifecycle state. Per admin/specs/ai-page-tools-v1.md. |
| `data-context-state` | `ok`, `large`, `missing` |  | Reflects extracted page context size against the Nano budget. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ai-chat:state` | `{ state, provider }` | Fires on every data-state transition. |
| `ai-chat:message` | `{ role, text }` | Fires once per completed message (user or assistant). |
| `ai-chat:context-overflow` | `{}` | Bubbled from the underlying session's contextoverflow event. |
| `ai-chat:error` | `{ error }` | Fires when generation fails. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `reset()` | Abort any reply, destroy the current session, and clear the log and the conversation history sent to endpoints. |
| `stop()` | Abort the in-flight reply, if any. Same as the Stop button or Escape. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Live region
- The component manages: `role="log"`, `role="group"`, `aria-live`, `aria-label`, `aria-busy`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` | Send the message | Focus in the message field (handled by chat-input) |
| `Escape` | Stop the reply that is being generated; the draft in the message field is kept | While a reply is streaming |

---

# <ai-summary>

Summarise wrapped content via Chrome's Summarizer API, with optional inline endpoint fallback and external deep-link fallback. Conforms to admin/specs/ai-page-tools-v1.md.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/ai-summary/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<ai-summary type="key-points" length="medium" format="markdown">
  <article>
    <h2>Headline</h2>
    <p>Body content…</p>
  </article>
</ai-summary>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `key-points`, `tldr`, `teaser`, `headline` | `key-points` | Summarizer type — passed through to Summarizer.create(). |
| `length` | `short`, `medium`, `long` | `medium` | Summary length hint. |
| `format` | `markdown`, `plain-text` | `markdown` | Output format. plain-text output is rendered as text (no markdown-viewer). |
| `shared-context` | string |  | Optional shared context passed to Summarizer.create(). |
| `endpoint` | string |  | Inline-fallback HTTP URL (POST JSON, streamed text/plain or one-shot application/json). Wire format: admin/specs/ai-page-tools-v1.md §C. |
| `fallback-url` | string |  | Deep-link URL template. Tokens: {prompt} {url} {title} {content}. {content} is the wrapped text, capped at 1500 characters. Provider-neutral. |
| `fallback-label` | string |  | Override the trigger label when in deep-link mode. |
| `fallback-prompt` | string | `Summarize this article: {url}` | Override the {prompt} string substituted into fallback-url. |
| `data-state` | `checking`, `ready`, `downloading`, `streaming`, `complete`, `error`, `unavailable`, `deep-link` |  | Lifecycle state. Per admin/specs/ai-page-tools-v1.md. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ai-summary:state` | `{ state, provider }` | Fires on every data-state transition. Provider is one of 'local'\|'endpoint'\|'deep-link'\|'unavailable'. |
| `ai-summary:result` | `{ text, provider }` | Fires once with the full summary on stream completion. |
| `ai-summary:error` | `{ error }` | Fires on any failure path (network, AI API, parsing). |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `stop()` | Abort the in-flight summary, if any. Same as the Stop button or Escape. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Live region
- The component manages: `role="status"`, `aria-live`, `aria-busy`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Escape` | Stop the summary that is being generated | While a summary is being generated |

| `data-state` | `active`, `debug`, `paused`, `off` |  | Reflected runtime state: active (sending), debug (console transport), paused (visitor paused this tab), off (any other reason) |

# <audio-player>

Platform audio player web component

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/audio-player/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<audio-player>
  <audio controls>
    <source src="track.ogg" type="audio/ogg">
    <source src="track.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
    <p><a href="track.mp3" download>Download track</a></p>
  </audio>
</audio-player>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `autoplay` | boolean |  | Start playing on load (subject to browser autoplay policy) |
| `loop` | boolean |  | Single track: sets the native audio.loop. Playlist: wrap to the first track after the last; with shuffle, start a new shuffle cycle |
| `shuffle` | boolean |  | Advance to a random track: each track plays once per cycle, never twice in a row. Without loop, playback stops at the end of the cycle |
| `state` | `playing`, `paused`, `ended` |  | Reflected playback state, set by the component |
| `muted` | boolean |  | Reflects the inner audio.muted (set by the mute button, the M shortcut or script) |
| `data-state` | `error` |  | "error" when the audio (or every <source>) fails to load; a visible, politely announced message is shown. Cleared when a source loads |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controls` | audio | boolean |  | Native controls for the no-JS fallback. Removed while the component is upgraded, restored when it disconnects |
| `data-audio-active` | li | boolean |  | The loaded track. Author sets the initial one; the component moves it and keeps it on a track after it ends |
| `data-audio-played` | li | boolean |  | Set by the component when the track plays to the end |
| `data-audio-favorite` | li | boolean |  | Author-set editorial highlight (heart marker) |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `audio` | The native audio element (light DOM); the component renders custom controls for it |
| `ol.track-list` | Optional playlist (usually inside <details>): one <li> per track with an <a href> to the file |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audio-player:play` | `{ currentTime, src }` | Playback started |
| `audio-player:pause` | `{ currentTime }` | Playback paused |
| `audio-player:ended` | `{ src }` | A track played to the end |
| `audio-player:track-change` | `{ src, title }` | A playlist track was activated (click or auto-advance) |
| `audio-player:src-changed` | `{ src, source: 'property' }` | The src property was set |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | Get/set the inner <audio> source. Setting loads it, refreshes the title, moves data-audio-active to a matching track link and fires audio-player:src-changed |
| `currentTime` | `number` | Playback position in seconds (proxies audio.currentTime) |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--audio-player-accent` | Play button, slider thumbs and progress fill colour |
| `--audio-player-bg` | Player background and slider thumb border |
| `--audio-player-radius` | Player border radius |
| `--audio-player-text` | Track title and controls text colour |
| `--audio-player-border` | Player border and slider track colour |
| `--audio-player-shadow` | Player box shadow (opt-in, default none) |
| `--audio-player-padding` | Controls row padding |

## Parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `player` | Outer player container |
| `controls` | Controls row |
| `play-button` | Play/pause button |
| `track-info` | Track title and time display |
| `timeline` | Seek range input |
| `volume` | Volume range input |
| `error` | Load-error message (hidden unless data-state="error") |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native media controls
- You provide: An <audio> element, and an aria-label on the player when the default "Audio player" does not describe it
- The component manages: `role="group"`, `role="status"`, `aria-label`, `aria-keyshortcuts`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-valuetext`, `aria-hidden`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Space` | Play or pause | Focus anywhere inside the player, except on a button, the playlist summary or a text field |
| `ArrowLeft` | Seek back 10 seconds | Focus anywhere inside the player, except on the seek or volume slider or a text field |
| `ArrowRight` | Seek forward 10 seconds | Focus anywhere inside the player, except on the seek or volume slider or a text field |
| `m` / `M` | Mute or unmute | Focus anywhere inside the player, except in a text field |

# <audio-visualizer>

Canvas-based audio visualization companion

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/audio-visualizer/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<audio-player>
  <audio id="demo-track" controls>
    <source src="track.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
    <p><a href="track.mp3" download>Download track</a></p>
  </audio>
</audio-player>
<audio-visualizer for="demo-track" data-mode="bars"></audio-visualizer>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `for` | string |  | Required. ID of the target <audio> element |
| `data-mode` | string |  | Visualization mode: "bars" (default), "waveform", "circle" |
| `data-fft-size` | number |  | AnalyserNode FFT size (power of 2, 32-32768). Default: 256. Other values are rounded to the nearest power of two and clamped to that range |
| `data-state` | `cross-origin`, `error` |  | Set when the visualizer cannot hook the audio: "cross-origin" (cross-origin source without crossorigin + CORS — left unhooked so it stays audible) or "error" (Web Audio connection failed). Absent while visualizing normally |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Decorative canvas
- The component manages: `aria-hidden`

Author-grouped view of site content. Fetches a pages.json-shaped source (or enhances authored fallback markup, including when the fetch fails) and adds a diacritic-insensitive filter with a polite live result count.


## Attributes

| `src` | string |  | Alias for data-lens-src |
| `placeholder` | string | `Filter authors…` | Search input placeholder; also the input's accessible name |
| `sort` | `alpha`, `count` | `alpha` | Group order: alphabetical by author, or by page count (descending, ties alphabetical). Applies to fetched data only |
| `heading-level` | `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6` | `2` | Level of the generated "Authors (N)" heading (fetched data only) |

# <brand-mark>

Brand/logo display. Authored content is never modified; the src attribute adds one owned <picture data-brand-mark-img> logo with optional dark-mode and compact variants

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/brand-mark/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<brand-mark>
  <img src="/logo.svg" alt="" />
  Acme Inc
</brand-mark>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | string |  | Logo image URL (light mode / default). Inserts an owned <picture data-brand-mark-img>; removing it removes only that element |
| `src-dark` | string |  | Dark-mode logo URL; follows <html data-mode>, then the resolved color-scheme, then prefers-color-scheme |
| `src-compact` | string |  | Compact/icon logo URL, used while compact-media matches (a <source> in the owned <picture>) |
| `compact-media` | string |  | Media query for src-compact (default: (width < 48rem), the --bp-m breakpoint) |
| `alt` | string |  | Logo text alternative. Image-only: becomes the accessible name and authored content is hidden from AT. Otherwise used only when there is no authored text |
| `wordmark` | boolean |  | Show authored content alongside the src logo (without it, authored content is visually hidden but stays the accessible name) |
| `height` | string |  | Logo height: a number (px) or a CSS length; sets --brand-mark-height |
| `data-size` | `s`, `l`, `xl` |  | Size variant |
| `data-stack` | boolean |  | Stack logo, name and tagline vertically |
| `data-brand-mark-img` |  |  | Marks the <picture> the component owns (inserted from src) |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Image with text alternative
- You provide: Text content naming the brand, or an alt attribute when the logo image stands alone
- The component manages: `alt`

# <bread-crumb>

Hierarchical navigation trail. Wraps existing <ol> markup HTML-first (canonical markup: inside <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">), or auto-generates from window.location.pathname. Emits BreadcrumbList JSON-LD for SEO.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/bread-crumb/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">
  <bread-crumb>
    <ol>
      <li><a href="/docs/">Docs</a></li>
      <li><a href="/docs/elements/">Elements</a></li>
      <li><span aria-current="page">Bread Crumb</span></li>
    </ol>
  </bread-crumb>
</nav>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-from-pathname` | boolean |  | When present, auto-generates the trail from window.location.pathname. Each path segment is URL-decoded and becomes a crumb (Title-Cased by default; override per segment via the .labels property). A leading Home crumb is always added. |
| `data-current-label` | string |  | Label for the final (current page) crumb when auto-generating. Takes precedence over .labels; if omitted, .labels or the Title-Cased last path segment is used. |
| `data-separator` | string |  | Separator glyph variant: 'chevron', 'arrow', 'dot', 'pipe'. Unset uses the theme's --sep-breadcrumb token (› by default). Drives the --_separator CSS var; separators are decorative (empty CSS alt text) and not announced. |
| `data-collapsed` | boolean |  | Hide middle crumbs, keeping the first crumb, the parent (second-to-last) and the current page. With four or more crumbs the component inserts an ellipsis <button aria-expanded> (accessible name 'Show full path') after the first crumb that reveals the hidden crumbs. |
| `data-jsonld` | string |  | BreadcrumbList JSON-LD emission: 'on' (default) or 'off'. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-truncated` | li | boolean |  | Apply to a crumb <li> to truncate its link/label with an ellipsis (max-inline-size 10rem). The full text is still read by screen readers. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<ol>` | The trail; one <li> per crumb containing an <a> (ancestors) or <span> (current page). Generated in data-from-pathname mode. |
| `<li data-crumb-toggle>` | Injected by data-collapsed: wraps the 'Show full path' <button aria-expanded>. Excluded from aria-current and JSON-LD. |
| `<script type="application/ld+json">` | Appended BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (unless data-jsonld="off"); item URLs are the anchors' resolved hrefs. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bread-crumb:upgraded` |  | Fired after setup completes |
| `bread-crumb:toggle` | `{ expanded }` | Fired when the data-collapsed toggle button expands or collapses the trail |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `labels` | `Record<string, string>` | Segment → label map for data-from-pathname mode. Keys may be a full pathname ('/docs/elements/'), a pathname without the trailing slash, or a single (decoded or raw) segment; '/' or 'home' relabels the Home crumb. Assigning re-renders the trail. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Breadcrumb
- You provide: An <ol> of links, or a <nav aria-label> around the list
- The component manages: `role="navigation"`, `aria-label`, `aria-current`, `aria-expanded`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Show or hide the collapsed crumbs | Native behaviour of <button> (the ellipsis toggle) |

---

# <calendar-event>

CSS-only event block for <day-view>, <week-view> and the <calendar-wc> day detail: category colour, inline-start accent bar, half-hour placement. Multi-hour spans are positioned by the parent view's JavaScript.

- CSS-only custom element. Works without JavaScript.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/custom-elements/calendar-event/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<calendar-event data-category="meeting">
  <time datetime="09:00">9:00</time>
  <icon-wc name="users" size="sm"></icon-wc>
  Sprint standup
</calendar-event>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-category` | string |  | Sets --event-color. Built in: meeting, deadline, personal, focus; any other value works with your own [data-category] rule. |
| `data-start` | `30` |  | Minute offset within the hour row. "30" places a single-hour event in the bottom half; day-view and week-view auto mode set it from the <time> when minutes >= 30. |
| `data-duration` | string |  | Length of a spanning event as hours and/or minutes, e.g. 2h, 45m, 1h30m, 90m. Read by <day-view>/<week-view> JS, which positions the event absolutely across hour rows. Unparseable values fall back to 1 hour. |
| `data-date` | string |  | ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the event. Required for <week-view> auto mode, which places the event in that day's column; ignored by <day-view>. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<time datetime="HH:MM">` | Start time label. The first <time datetime> is what day-view/week-view auto mode use to place the event; without one, day-view auto mode moves the event to its all-day list and week-view auto mode skips it. |
| `<time datetime="PT…">` | Optional human-readable duration. Visually hidden, still read by assistive tech. Not used for positioning: use data-duration. |
| `<a href> or <button>` | Put interactive content inside when the event is actionable; the block shows a pointer cursor and hover tint only then. The event element itself is not interactive. |

---

# <calendar-wc>

Standalone calendar display with rich cell content

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/calendar-wc/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<calendar-wc
  data-month="4" data-year="2026"
  data-events='{"2026-04-10":"Sprint review","2026-04-15":"Deadline"}'
  data-selection="single">
</calendar-wc>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-month` | string |  | Month to display (1-12). Defaults to the current month. Observed; reflected back as the view changes. |
| `data-year` | string |  | Year to display. Defaults to the current year. Observed; reflected back as the view changes. |
| `data-events` | string |  | JSON: events keyed by start ISO date. Values may be a string, an object, or an array of events. Each event accepts optional `end` (ISO date, inclusive) or `days` (count) to span multiple days; spans render as continuous bars in data-size="large". Observed: changes re-render and fire calendar-wc:events-changed with source "attribute". |
| `data-selection` | `none`, `single`, `range`, `multi` | `none` | Selection mode: "none" (default), "single", "range", "multi" |
| `data-size` | `compact`, `default`, `large` | `default` | Size: "compact", "default", "large" |
| `data-min-date` | string |  | Earliest selectable/navigable date (ISO string, e.g. 2026-01-01) |
| `data-max-date` | string |  | Latest selectable/navigable date (ISO string, e.g. 2026-12-31) |
| `data-disabled-dates` | string |  | Comma-separated ISO dates to disable |
| `data-highlight-dates` | string |  | Comma-separated ISO dates to highlight (optionally with :category) |
| `data-months` | number |  | Number of adjacent months to display side by side (1-12). Defaults to 1. |
| `data-year-range` | number | `10` | Years listed either side of the current year in the year select (0-200). data-min-date / data-max-date bound that side instead, and the displayed year is always listed. |
| `data-heading-level` | number |  | Multi-month views: render each month title as <h1>-<h6> at this level. Default: plain text (no heading). |
| `data-label-prev` | string | `Previous month` | Accessible name override (default "Previous month"). |
| `data-label-next` | string | `Next month` | Accessible name override (default "Next month"). |
| `data-label-year` | string | `Year` | Accessible name override (default "Year"). |
| `data-label-close` | string | `Close` | Accessible name override (default "Close"). |
| `data-label-more` | string | `+{n} more` | Large-view overflow text; {n} is replaced with the hidden event count. |
| `name` | string |  | Form participation name. Enables ElementInternals form value sync on selection. |
| `data-tentative` | string |  | Range mode: the ISO start date while the second click is pending. Removed when the range completes. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-date` | button | string |  | ISO date of an in-month day button (runtime) |
| `data-day` | button | number |  | Day-of-month number on every day button, including outside-month ones (runtime) |
| `data-highlight` | button | string |  | Highlight category from data-highlight-dates (runtime) |
| `aria-current` | button | `date` |  | Marks today (runtime) |
| `aria-selected` | td | `true`, `false` |  | Selection state of the gridcell in selection modes (runtime) |
| `data-selected` | td | boolean |  | Selected day (single/multi) — styling hook (runtime) |
| `data-range-start` | td | boolean |  | First day of the range (runtime) |
| `data-range-end` | td | boolean |  | Last day of the range (runtime) |
| `data-in-range` | td | boolean |  | Day inside the range, inclusive (runtime) |
| `data-today` | td | boolean |  | Today's cell (runtime) |
| `data-outside-month` | td | boolean |  | Leading/trailing day from an adjacent month (runtime) |
| `data-events` | td | boolean |  | Cell has at least one event (runtime) |
| `data-event-count` | td | number |  | Number of events covering the day, spans included (runtime) |
| `data-day-part` | td | string |  | Space-separated tokens returned by getDayParts (runtime) |
| `data-week` | tr | number |  | 1-based week row index (runtime) |
| `data-row-lanes` | tr | number |  | Large view: number of span-bar lanes in the row (runtime) |
| `data-event-dot` | span | boolean |  | One event dot in compact/default views (runtime) |
| `data-continues-start` | span.event-span | boolean |  | Span bar continues from the previous row (runtime) |
| `data-continues-end` | span.event-span | boolean |  | Span bar continues into the next row (runtime) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `calendar:select` | `{ value, date } (single) \| { value, start, end, startDate, endDate } (range) \| { values, dates } (multi)` | Fired when the selection changes |
| `calendar:navigate` | `{ year, month }` | Fired on month/year navigation |
| `calendar:day-open` | `{ date, events }` | Fired when the day-detail dialog opens (display mode) |
| `calendar-wc:events-changed` | `{ events, source: 'property' \| 'attribute' }` | Fired after the event data changes via the events property or the data-events attribute |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `refresh()` | Re-render the current view (e.g. after data read by a callback changes) |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string \| null` | Read-only selection: ISO date (single), ISO interval start/end (range), space-separated ISO dates (multi), or null |
| `events` | `{ [isoDate]: Event[] } \| Array<Event & { date }>` | Get the date-keyed event map, or assign a date-keyed object or flat array (grouped by date) to re-render; fires calendar-wc:events-changed with source 'property' |
| `isDateDisallowed` | `((date: Date) => boolean) \| null` | Callback; return true to disable a date. Additive with data-min/max-date and data-disabled-dates |
| `getDayParts` | `((date: Date) => string \| string[] \| null) \| null` | Callback; returned tokens are set as data-day-part on the cell's <td> |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Grid
- The component manages: `role="grid"`, `role="dialog"`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-selected`, `aria-multiselectable`, `aria-current`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-live`, `aria-hidden`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrowRight` | Move focus to the next day (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus on a day |
| `ArrowLeft` | Move focus to the previous day (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus on a day |
| `ArrowDown` | Move focus to the same weekday in the next week | Focus on a day |
| `ArrowUp` | Move focus to the same weekday in the previous week | Focus on a day |
| `Home` | Move focus to the first day of the week row within the month | Focus on a day |
| `End` | Move focus to the last day of the week row within the month | Focus on a day |
| `PageUp` | Move focus to the same day in the previous month | Focus on a day |
| `PageDown` | Move focus to the same day in the next month | Focus on a day |
| `Shift+PageUp` | Move focus to the same day in the previous year | Focus on a day |
| `Shift+PageDown` | Move focus to the same day in the next year | Focus on a day |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Select the day, or open its event detail when selection is off | Native behaviour of <button> |
| `Escape` | Close the day detail and return focus to the day | Day detail open |

# <card-list>

Template-based list rendering with safe data binding: property paths only, sanitized HTML, and URL-checked attribute bindings

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/card-list/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<card-list data-layout="grid" data-items='[
  {"id": 1, "name": "Headphones", "price": "$249", "inStock": true},
  {"id": 2, "name": "Keyboard", "price": "$159", "inStock": true},
  {"id": 3, "name": "Monitor", "price": "$449", "inStock": false}
]' data-key="id">
  <template>
    <layout-card>
      <header><h3 data-field="name"></h3></header>
      <section>
        <p data-field="price"></p>
      </section>
      <footer>
        <button data-field-if="inStock">Add to Cart</button>
        <span data-field-unless="inStock">Out of Stock</span>
      </footer>
    </layout-card>
  </template>
</card-list>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | string |  | URL to fetch JSON items from (an array, or an object with items/data). Fetched once on upgrade and on change; a newer src aborts the older request. |
| `data-items` | string |  | Inline JSON array of items. Takes priority over src. |
| `data-key` | string | `id` | Item property used as the unique key for the keyed diff. Missing or duplicated keys fall back to the item index. |
| `data-loading` | boolean |  | Present while a src fetch is in flight (with aria-busy="true"). |
| `data-error` | string |  | Error message of the last failed src fetch; cleared when a new fetch starts. Also announced via the role="status" child. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-field` | template descendant | string |  | Set the element's text content from a property path (e.g. user.name). |
| `data-field-attr` | template descendant | string |  | Comma-separated 'attribute: path' pairs. on* attributes, style and srcdoc are refused; URL attributes (href, src, action, formaction, poster, srcset, ...) only accept http(s), mailto, tel, relative or fragment URLs. null/undefined removes the attribute. |
| `data-field-html` | template descendant | string |  | Set innerHTML from a property path, passed through the shared sanitizer. |
| `data-field-if` | template descendant | string |  | Element is [hidden] unless the property value is truthy. |
| `data-field-unless` | template descendant | string |  | Element is [hidden] when the property value is truthy. |
| `data-fallback` | direct child | boolean |  | Static no-JS content; removed on the first successful render. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `template` | Card template cloned per item. A single root element enables the keyed diff. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `card-list:rendered` | `{ count }` | Fired after items are rendered or reconciled. |
| `card-list:items-changed` | `{ items, source: 'attribute' \| 'api' }` | Fired when the items change. source is 'attribute' for data-items, src and data-key, 'api' for the .items setter. |
| `card-list:upgraded` |  | Fired once the component has found its template and upgraded. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Array<object>` | Get the current items, or assign an array to re-render via the keyed diff (cancels an in-flight src fetch). setItems()/getItems() were removed. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Live region
- You provide: A <template> whose markup is accessible on its own (headings, link text, alt text)
- The component manages: `role="status"`, `aria-busy`, `hidden`

---

# <carousel-wc>

Scrolling carousel with autoplay, looping, indicators, and view transitions

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/carousel/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<carousel-wc aria-label="Product photos">
  <div>Slide 1</div>
  <div>Slide 2</div>
  <div>Slide 3</div>
</carousel-wc>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `autoplay` | boolean |  | Auto-advance slides and render a pause/play rotation control (ignored under reduced motion) |
| `autoplay-delay` | number |  | Delay between auto-advance in milliseconds (default 5000) |
| `loop` | boolean |  | Loop back to start after last slide |
| `indicators` | string |  | Show dot indicators; "false" hides them |
| `item-width` | string |  | Slide width: "full" (default), "auto" (content width), or a CSS length such as "18rem" |
| `gap` | `xs`, `s`, `m`, `l`, `xl` |  | Gap between slides |
| `start` | number |  | Initial slide index |
| `persist` | string |  | localStorage key for position persistence |
| `transition` | `fade`, `slide`, `scale` |  | View Transition animation between slides |
| `data-label-track` | string | `Slides` | Accessible name of the focusable slide track |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `any child elements` | Each direct child becomes a slide |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `carousel-wc:change` | `{ index, slide }` | Fired once per slide change (scroll settling is debounced) |
| `carousel-wc:play` |  | Fired when the autoplay timer starts or resumes (including after a hover/focus suspension ends) |
| `carousel-wc:pause` |  | Fired when the autoplay timer stops: explicit pause, or a hover/focus/touch suspension |
| `carousel-wc:slides-changed` | `{ slides, source: 'property' }` | Fired after the slides property rebuilds the carousel |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `next()` | Go to the next slide (wraps with loop) |
| `prev()` | Go to the previous slide (wraps with loop) |
| `goTo(index, smooth = true)` | Jump to a slide; out-of-range indexes are ignored |
| `play()` | Start or resume rotation; overrides a hover/focus suspension. No-op under reduced motion |
| `pause()` | Stop rotation until play() or the rotation control resumes it |
| `reset()` | Return to the start slide and clear persistence |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `currentIndex` | `number` | Current slide index (read-only) |
| `slideCount` | `number` | Number of slides (read-only) |
| `playing` | `boolean` | Whether the autoplay timer is running right now (read-only; false while suspended by hover/focus) |
| `slides` | `Array<{ id?, html, label? }>` | Get the slides as data, or assign records to rebuild the carousel |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Carousel
- You provide: An aria-label on the carousel when the default "Carousel" does not describe it; an aria-label on a slide replaces the generated "n of total"; data-label-track renames the slide track (default "Slides")
- The component manages: `role="region"`, `role="group"`, `aria-roledescription`, `aria-label`, `aria-current`, `aria-live`, `aria-atomic`, `tabindex`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrowRight` | Go to the next slide (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus on the slide track |
| `ArrowLeft` | Go to the previous slide (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus on the slide track |
| `Home` | Go to the first slide | Focus on the slide track |
| `End` | Go to the last slide | Focus on the slide track |

# <change-set>

Interactive change tracking group: a caption from author/datetime plus Tracking / Final / Original toggles over its <ins> / <del> descendants

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/change-set/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<change-set datetime="2026-02-20" author="tpowell">
  <p>
    Send requests to
    <del>/api/v1/upload</del>
    <ins>/api/v2/ingest</ins>
    with a
    <del>Content-Type: application/xml</del>
    <ins>Content-Type: application/json</ins>
    header.
  </p>
</change-set>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `view` | `final`, `original` |  | Which text is visible: final (insertions only), original (deletions only); omitted = tracking (both, with announced markers). Observed; works without JS |
| `datetime` | string |  | ISO date of the change set; rendered in the caption and the controls' name |
| `author` | string |  | Author of the changes; rendered in the caption and the controls' name |
| `controls` | `none` |  | "none" renders no toggle controls (fixed view) |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-controls` | div | boolean |  | Set by the component on the role="group" toggle container |
| `data-action` | button | `tracking`, `final`, `original` |  | Set by the component: the view a toggle selects |
| `aria-pressed` | button | `true`, `false` |  | Set by the component: true on the toggle matching the current view |
| `data-change-caption` | p | boolean |  | Set by the component on the author/datetime caption |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change-set:view` | `{ view: 'tracking' \| 'final' \| 'original', source?: 'api' }` | View changed via the toggles (no source) or the view property (source: 'api'). Bubbles |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `view` | `'tracking' \| 'final' \| 'original'` | Get / set the view. Setting the current view is a no-op; unknown values are ignored |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `undefined` |  |
| `undefined` |  |
| `undefined` |  |
| `undefined` |  |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Button
- You provide: <ins> and <del> elements marking the changes
- The component manages: `role="group"`, `aria-label`, `aria-pressed`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Switch to that view of the changes | Native behaviour of <button> |

# <chart-wc>

SVG chart component with progressive enhancement: semantic table → CSS chart → SVG chart.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/chart-wc/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<chart-wc
  data-type="line"
  data-title="Weekly Users"
  data-label-x="Day of Week"
  data-label-y="Users"
  data-legend
  data-tooltip
  data-values='[
    {"name": "Desktop", "values": {"Mon": 120, "Tue": 180, "Wed": 150, "Thu": 210, "Fri": 190, "Sat": 80, "Sun": 60}},
    {"name": "Mobile",  "values": {"Mon": 80,  "Tue": 120, "Wed": 160, "Thu": 140, "Fri": 200, "Sat": 220, "Sun": 180}}
  ]'>
</chart-wc>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-type` | `bar`, `column`, `line`, `area`, `pie`, `ring`, `scatter`, `bubble` |  | Chart type to render |
| `data-values` | string |  | Chart data as JSON string |
| `data-config` | string |  | Chart config overrides as JSON string |
| `data-title` | string |  | Chart title text; also the caption of the generated data table |
| `data-subtitle` | string |  | Subtitle shown under data-title (requires data-title) |
| `data-label-x` | string |  | X / category axis label; also the category column header of the generated data table |
| `data-label-y` | string |  | Y / value axis label |
| `data-legend` | (no value), `true`, `false` | `true` | Series legend with show/hide checkboxes. On by default; "false" hides it (bare or "true" keeps it on). Wins over data-config. Moves under the plot when the chart is 400px wide or less. |
| `data-tooltip` | (no value), `true`, `false` | `true` | Hover tooltips. On by default; "false" turns them off (bare or "true" keeps them on). Wins over data-config. |
| `data-palette` | string |  | Custom color palette as JSON array |
| `data-chart` | `replace`, `enhance` |  | How to handle an authored source table: replace (default) visually hides it after the chart mounts but keeps it in the accessibility tree; enhance keeps it visible. Also readable from the table's own data-chart. |
| `data-size` | `sparkline` |  | Render mode. sparkline strips all chrome (axes, ticks, gridlines, labels, title, legend, tooltip) for use as an inline trend chart sized by its container. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-chart-series` | th | boolean |  | Mark this column as a data series for chart extraction |
| `data-chart-label` | th | boolean |  | Mark this column as the label/category axis |
| `data-chart-ignore` | th | boolean |  | Exclude this column from chart data extraction |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<table>` | Optional source table — data is extracted; the table stays the screen-reader (and print) version of the chart. Without one, chart-wc generates a table[data-chart-generated] from the data. |
| `<script type='application/json'>` | Optional inline JSON data source |
| `<template data-chart-data>` | Optional template-based JSON data source |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chart-wc:render` | `{ type, seriesCount }` | Fired after SVG chart renders successfully |
| `chart-wc:error` | `{ message }` | Fired when no data is found or chart rendering fails (the data table is then left visible) |
| `chart-wc:config-resolved` | `{ type, config }` | Fired before each render with the merged engine config (mutable, for last-minute tweaks) |
| `chart-wc:data-changed` | `{ data, config, source: 'property' }` | Fired when .data or .config is assigned |
| `chart-wc:upgraded` |  | Fired once after the component upgrades; safe signal for the first .data assignment |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `refresh()` | Re-extract table data and re-render |
| `toSVG()` | Get current SVG markup |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `Array\|Object` | Get/set chart data programmatically |
| `config` | `Object` | Get/set chart config programmatically |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Image with data table alternative
- You provide: A data table or data source, and a data-title (used as the table caption or the image name)
- The component manages: `role="img"`, `aria-hidden`, `aria-label`, `tabindex`, `hidden`

# <chat-input>

Form-associated chat input with auto-growing textarea; submits its form, or fires chat-input:send when standalone

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Form-associated: takes part in form submission and validation.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/chat-input/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<chat-input name="message">
  <textarea data-grow rows="1" data-max-rows="8" aria-label="Message"
            placeholder="Ask anything..."></textarea>
  <footer>
    <button type="submit" class="small" data-send aria-label="Send">
      <icon-wc name="send"></icon-wc>
    </button>
  </footer>
</chat-input>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | Form field name; required for the value to appear in FormData (no default) |
| `maxlength` | number | `4000` | Character limit; over it the element is invalid (tooLong) and sending is blocked |
| `minlength` | number | `1` | Minimum trimmed length to send |
| `disabled` | boolean |  | Disables the textarea and send button (an ancestor fieldset[disabled] does the same) |
| `autofocus` | boolean |  | Focus textarea on connect |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-send` | button | boolean |  | Marks the send button; submits the form or fires chat-input:send |
| `data-grow` | textarea | boolean |  | Auto-resize the textarea (VB textarea-grow utility) |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `textarea` | The message field; give it an accessible name (aria-label="Message" is added when it has none) |
| `button[data-send]` | Send button |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chat-input:send` | `{ message }` | Enter or send button when not inside a form; message is trimmed and the input clears afterwards |
| `chat-input:input` | `{ value, length }` | Keystroke, debounced 100ms |
| `chat-input:change` | `{ value, source: 'api' }` | The value property was set to a new value |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `focus()` | Focus the textarea |
| `reset()` | Clear the value and resize |
| `checkValidity()` | Native constraint validation check |
| `reportValidity()` | Check validity and show the browser message on the textarea |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | Current textarea content (get/set; setting fires chat-input:change) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Reflects the disabled attribute |
| `form` | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The associated form (read-only) |
| `name` | `string` | The name attribute (read-only) |
| `validity` | `ValidityState` | Constraint validation state (read-only) |
| `validationMessage` | `string` | Current validation message (read-only) |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native form controls
- You provide: A <textarea> with a label (otherwise it is named "Message") and a named send button
- The component manages: `aria-label`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` | Send the message | Focus in the message field |
| `Escape` | Clear the message field | Focus in the message field |

---

# <chat-message>

A single chat turn with role-based alignment, optional avatar support, sender metadata, and message state indicators.

- CSS-only custom element. Works without JavaScript.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/custom-elements/chat-message/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<chat-message data-role="user">
  <chat-bubble><p>Hello, I need help with my order.</p></chat-bubble>
</chat-message>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-role` | `user`, `agent`, `system` |  |  |
| `data-from` | string |  |  |
| `data-from-label` | string |  |  |
| `data-status` | string |  |  |
| `data-model` | string |  |  |

# <chat-thread>

Scrollable message container for chat conversations. Grows to fill available height; add role='log' for screen reader announcements.

- CSS-only custom element. Works without JavaScript.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/custom-elements/chat-thread/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<chat-thread role="log" aria-label="Support conversation" aria-live="polite" tabindex="0">
  <chat-message data-role="agent" data-from-label="Bot">
    <chat-bubble><p>Welcome! How can I help?</p></chat-bubble>
  </chat-message>
  <chat-message data-role="user">
    <chat-bubble><p>I have a question.</p></chat-bubble>
  </chat-message>
</chat-thread>
```

---

# <chat-window>

Light DOM orchestrator for chat UI

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/chat-window/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<chat-window endpoint="/api/ai" model="claude-sonnet-4-6">
  <script type="application/json" data-participants>
  {
    "user":      { "name": "You", "role": "user" },
    "assistant": { "name": "Assistant", "role": "agent" }
  }
  </script>
  <header>
    <h3>AI Assistant</h3>
    <select data-model-select aria-label="Select model">
      <option value="claude-sonnet-4-6">Sonnet 4.6</option>
      <option value="claude-opus-4-6">Opus 4.6</option>
      <option value="claude-haiku-4-5">Haiku 4.5</option>
    </select>
  </header>
  <chat-thread role="log" aria-label="AI conversation" aria-live="polite">
  </chat-thread>
  <chat-input name="message">
    <textarea data-grow rows="1" data-max-rows="8" aria-label="Message"
              placeholder="Ask anything..."></textarea>
    <footer>
      <button type="submit" class="small" data-send aria-label="Send">
        <icon-wc name="send"></icon-wc>
      </button>
    </footer>
  </chat-input>
</chat-window>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | string |  | API endpoint; POSTs { message, model } (latest message only) and reads html/message/content from the JSON reply. Omit for custom transport |
| `model` | string |  | Active model; synced with [data-model-select] (property-driven after connect) |
| `empty-message` | string | `Send a message to start.` | Empty thread placeholder text |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-participants` | script | boolean |  | JSON participant map: { id: { name, role } } |
| `data-model-select` | select | boolean |  | Model selector inside the header; synced with model |
| `data-role` | chat-message | `user`, `agent`, `system` |  | Message role; user content is always text |
| `data-from` | chat-message | string |  | Participant id, resolved to data-from-label |
| `data-from-label` | chat-message | string |  | Sender name (written by the runtime from participants) |
| `data-status` | chat-message | `typing`, `error` |  | Typing placeholder or failed reply |
| `data-model` | chat-message | string |  | Model attribution on agent replies |
| `data-chat-typing` | span | boolean |  | Visually hidden typing label inside a typing chat-bubble (runtime) |
| `data-chat-empty` | p | boolean |  | Empty-thread placeholder inside chat-thread (runtime) |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `chat-thread[role=log]` | Message list; always rendered |
| `chat-input` | Composer; its chat-input:send drives the send cycle |
| `header` | Title and optional select[data-model-select] |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chat-window:send` | `{ message, typingElement }` | A message was sent and no endpoint is set; finish with resolveTyping(typingElement, html) |
| `chat-window:error` | `{ error, status }` | The built-in fetch transport failed |
| `chat-window:model-change` | `{ model }` | The model selector changed |
| `chat-window:messages-changed` | `{ messages, source: 'property' }` | The messages setter updated the thread |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `appendMessage(role, content, from?)` | Append and return a chat-message; user content is text, other roles sanitized HTML |
| `resolveTyping(el, content, { error? })` | Finish a typing placeholder: fill its bubble, clear data-status (or set error) and the typing label |
| `clearThread()` | Remove all messages |
| `scrollToBottom()` | Scroll the thread to the newest message |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messages` | `Array<{ id, role, content, from? }>` | Get the thread as data, or assign to replace the whole thread (keyed diff by id); content is text for role user, sanitized HTML otherwise |
| `model` | `string` | Active model; syncs with select[data-model-select] |
| `participants` | `Map<string, { name, role }>` | Participant registry; setting re-resolves data-from-label |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Live region
- You provide: A <chat-thread role="log" aria-live="polite"> with an aria-label, and a chat-input
