# <color-picker>

Form-associated color picker with saturation/lightness area, hue slider, HEX/RGB/HSL/OKLCH inputs, preset swatches, Copy and EyeDropper

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/color-picker/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<form-field>
  <label for="brand">Brand color</label>
  <color-picker>
    <input type="color" id="brand" name="brand" value="#6366f1">
  </color-picker>
</form-field>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | Form field name. A name on the inner input (the no-JS path) moves here on upgrade so exactly one value submits. |
| `disabled` | boolean |  | Disables the trigger, closes the panel and drops the value from submission. A disabled ancestor fieldset has the same effect. |
| `format` | `hex`, `rgb`, `hsl`, `oklch` | `hex` | Initial input/copy format. The Format selector inside the panel switches it at runtime. |
| `data-label-area-value` | string | `Saturation {s}%, lightness {l}%` | Template for the aria-valuetext of the saturation and lightness area; {s} and {l} are replaced with the saturation and lightness percentages. |
| `open` | boolean |  | Reflected while the panel is open |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | input | string |  | Submission name for the no-JS fallback. Moved to the host on upgrade (the host's own name wins if both are set). |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<input type="color">` | Supplies the initial value (its value attribute is the form-reset target) and the no-JS fallback. Its <label for> names the trigger. |
| `<datalist>` | Preset swatches — one <option value="#hex">Name</option> per swatch |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color-picker:change` | `{ hex, rgb: { r, g, b }, hsl: { h, s, l }, source: 'pointer' \| 'keyboard' \| 'api' \| 'internal' }` | Fired when the color changes. source is 'api' for .value assignments, 'pointer'/'keyboard' for the area and hue slider, 'internal' for text inputs, swatches and the EyeDropper. |
| `color-picker:open` |  | Fired when the panel opens |
| `color-picker:close` |  | Fired when the panel closes |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Slider
- You provide: An <input type="color"> with a <label>
- The component manages: `role="dialog"`, `role="slider"`, `role="group"`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuetext`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-hidden`, `tabindex`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Open or close the picker panel | Native behaviour of <button> (the trigger) |
| `ArrowRight` | Increase saturation by 1 | Focus on the saturation and lightness area |
| `ArrowLeft` | Decrease saturation by 1 | Focus on the saturation and lightness area |
| `ArrowUp` | Increase lightness by 1 | Focus on the saturation and lightness area |
| `ArrowDown` | Decrease lightness by 1 | Focus on the saturation and lightness area |
| `Home` | Set saturation to 0 | Focus on the saturation and lightness area |
| `End` | Set saturation to 100 | Focus on the saturation and lightness area |
| `PageUp` | Increase lightness by 10 | Focus on the saturation and lightness area |
| `PageDown` | Decrease lightness by 10 | Focus on the saturation and lightness area |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowUp` | Increase hue by 1 degree | Focus on the hue slider |
| `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowDown` | Decrease hue by 1 degree | Focus on the hue slider |
| `PageUp` | Increase hue by 10 degrees | Focus on the hue slider |
| `PageDown` | Decrease hue by 10 degrees | Focus on the hue slider |
| `Home` | Set hue to 0 degrees | Focus on the hue slider |
| `End` | Set hue to 360 degrees | Focus on the hue slider |
| `Shift+ArrowRight` / `Shift+ArrowLeft` / `Shift+ArrowUp` / `Shift+ArrowDown` | Change the value by 10 instead of 1 | Focus on either slider |
| `Escape` | Close the panel; focus returns to the trigger when it was inside the panel | Panel open and focus on the trigger or inside the panel |

# <combo-box>

Autocomplete combobox with filtering, keyboard navigation, and native form association

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/combobox/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<label for="country">Country</label>
<combo-box>
  <input type="text" id="country" name="country" placeholder="Search countries...">
  <ul>
    <li data-value="us">United States</li>
    <li data-value="gb">United Kingdom</li>
    <li data-value="ca">Canada</li>
    <li data-value="au">Australia</li>
  </ul>
</combo-box>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | Form field name. A name on the inner input (the no-JS path) moves here on upgrade so exactly one value submits. |
| `required` | boolean |  | Require a selection for form validation |
| `disabled` | boolean |  | Disables the input and tag remove buttons, closes the listbox and drops the value from submission. A disabled ancestor fieldset has the same effect. |
| `filter` | `contains`, `startsWith` | `contains` | How typing filters the options |
| `value` | string |  | Selected value (single mode) |
| `placeholder` | string |  | Input placeholder text |
| `multiple` | boolean |  | Enable multi-select tag mode |
| `max` | number |  | Maximum number of tags (multi mode) |
| `custom` | boolean |  | Allow typed entries via Enter/comma (multi mode) |
| `open` | boolean |  | Reflected when the listbox is open |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-value` | li | string |  | Option value identifier placed on each <li> in the options list |
| `name` | input | string |  | Submission name for the no-JS fallback (submits the typed text). Moved to the host on upgrade (the host's own name wins if both are set). |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<input type="text">` | Text input for filtering and display. Give it an id and point a <label for> at it — the id and labels are preserved and name the combobox. |
| `<ul> or <ol>` | Options list container |
| `<li data-value>` | Individual option — one per selectable choice |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `combo-box:change` | `{ value, label, source } \| { values[], labels[], source }` | Fired when selection changes. source is 'api' for .value assignments, 'internal' for user picks. Re-choosing the current option closes the list without firing. |
| `combo-box:open` |  | Fired when the listbox opens |
| `combo-box:close` |  | Fired when the listbox closes |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Combobox
- You provide: A text input with a <label>, and a list of options
- The component manages: `role="combobox"`, `role="listbox"`, `role="option"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-selected`, `aria-multiselectable`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-live`, `aria-atomic`, `aria-label`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrowDown` | Open the list if closed and move to the next option, wrapping to the first |  |
| `ArrowUp` | Open the list if closed and move to the previous option, wrapping to the last |  |
| `Home` | Move to the first option | List open |
| `End` | Move to the last option | List open |
| `Enter` | Select the active option; in multiple mode with custom values, add the typed text as a tag. With no active option and nothing to add, Enter submits the form |  |
| `, ` | Add the typed text as a tag | Multiple mode with custom values |
| `Backspace` | Remove the last tag | Multiple mode, input empty |
| `Escape` | Close the list and keep focus in the input | List open |
| `Tab` | Close the list and move focus on | List open |

# <command-palette>

Command palette / Cmd+K launcher (modal dialog, combobox + listbox)

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/command-palette/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<command-palette hotkey="meta+k">
  <command-group label="Navigation">
    <command-item value="home" data-hotkey="shift+h">
      Go Home
    </command-item>
    <command-item value="settings">
      Settings
    </command-item>
  </command-group>
  <command-group label="Actions">
    <command-item value="theme">Toggle Dark Mode</command-item>
    <command-item value="copy">Copy Current URL</command-item>
  </command-group>
</command-palette>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hotkey` | string | `meta+k` | Global keyboard shortcut that toggles the palette (fires even in text fields) |
| `placeholder` | string | `Type a command...` | Search input placeholder text |
| `label` | string | `Command palette` | Accessible name of the dialog |
| `discover` | (no value), `auto` |  | Present: add commands from [data-command] / [commandfor] elements. "auto": also scan nav links and headings |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | command-group | string |  | Group header text |
| `value` | command-item | string |  | Value passed in command-palette:select detail.value |
| `data-hotkey` | command-item | string |  | Shortcut shown as a badge and bound page-wide while connected; fires command-palette:select without opening the palette (not in text fields) |
| `slot` | command-item > * | `icon` |  | slot="icon" marks the item's icon (cloned into the option) |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<command-group>` | Group of commands; rendered as a role="group" named by its label |
| `<command-item>` | One command inside a <command-group>; its text is the label, an element with slot="icon" the icon |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command-palette:select` | `{ value }` | Fired when a declared command is chosen from the list or by its data-hotkey |
| `command-palette:open` |  | Fired when the palette opens |
| `command-palette:close` |  | Fired once whenever the dialog closes (close(), selection, Escape, backdrop click) |
| `command-palette:commands-changed` | `{ commands, source: 'property' }` | Fired after the commands property rebuilds the palette |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open()` | Open the palette and focus the search input |
| `close()` | Close the palette |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `commands` | `Array<{ value, label, hotkey?, group?, icon? }>` | Get the declared commands as data, or assign to rebuild the groups |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` | Read-only. Whether the dialog is open |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Combobox
- You provide: A label for each command; a label attribute when the default "Command palette" does not describe the dialog
- The component manages: `role="combobox"`, `role="listbox"`, `role="group"`, `role="option"`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-controls`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-selected`, `aria-keyshortcuts`, `aria-hidden`, `tabindex`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Meta+k` / `Ctrl+k` | Open or close the palette (Meta on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere; set by the hotkey attribute) | Anywhere on the page |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the next command, wrapping to the first | Palette open |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the previous command, wrapping to the last | Palette open |
| `Enter` | Run the active command and close the palette | Palette open |
| `Escape` | Close the palette | Palette open |

# <comment-box>

Form-associated comment form composing <markdown-editor> + Submit / Cancel buttons. Used standalone or as the reply-form template inside <comment-thread>. Presentational with respect to persistence.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/comment-box/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<comment-box name="comment" placeholder="Add a comment…"></comment-box>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | Form field name (submitted with parent form). Stays on the host; the inner textarea is not named, so the value submits once. |
| `value` | string |  | Pre-filled markdown content (e.g. for edit mode) |
| `placeholder` | string |  | Editor placeholder text (forwarded to the inner <markdown-editor>) |
| `label` | string | `Comment` | Accessible name for the editor textarea. Falls back to an associated <label>'s text, then "Comment". |
| `submit-label` | string |  | Submit button label (default "Comment") |
| `cancel-label` | string |  | Cancel button label (default "Cancel") |
| `data-show-cancel` | boolean |  | Render the Cancel button |
| `data-min-length` | number |  | Minimum character length for validation |
| `data-max-length` | number |  | Maximum character length for validation; also shows a counter that announces only near or over the limit |
| `required` | boolean |  | Requires a non-empty value; a blocked submit reports the validation message |
| `disabled` | boolean |  | Disables the editor and buttons (a disabled ancestor <fieldset> does the same) |
| `aria-busy` | string |  | "true" while a comment-box:submit waitUntil() promise is pending |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | * | `toolbar` |  | slot="toolbar" children move into the tool group left of the buttons (kept across reconnects) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `comment-box:submit` | `{ value, waitUntil(promise) }` | Bubbles, cancelable, dispatched synchronously. Do nothing: the value clears. waitUntil(promise): the box is busy until it settles; resolve clears, reject keeps the value. preventDefault() (during the handler, not after an await): the value is kept and nothing else happens. An invalid value does not fire this; it reports the validation message instead. |
| `comment-box:cancel` | `{ value }` | Cancel button clicked, or Escape pressed while the Cancel button is shown |
| `comment-box:input` | `{ value, length }` | Fires on every keystroke and after clear() |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `clear()` | Clear the value and emit comment-box:input |
| `focus()` | Focus the editor textarea |
| `checkValidity()` | Standard form-associated validity check |
| `reportValidity()` | Check validity and show the message |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | Get/set the current markdown content |
| `busy` | `boolean` | Read-only. True while a submit waitUntil() promise is pending |
| `form` | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The associated form |
| `name` | `string \| null` | The name attribute |
| `validity` | `ValidityState` | Current validity |
| `validationMessage` | `string` | Current validation message |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native form controls
- You provide: A label attribute or an associated <label> (otherwise the field is named "Comment")
- The component manages: `role="group"`, `role="status"`, `aria-label`, `aria-busy`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+Enter` / `Meta+Enter` | Submit the comment | Focus in the comment field |
| `Escape` | Cancel, as the Cancel button does | data-show-cancel is set and focus is in the comment field or on its buttons |

---

# <comment-thread>

Persistent threaded-discussion container. Author renders <article data-comment> children with metadata; component decorates each with author header, relative timestamp, action row (Reply / Edit / Delete) + threaded indentation. Composes <comment-box> (reply form template) and bubbles <reaction-bar> events naturally. Bodies added through the API are text or sanitized HTML.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/comment-thread/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<comment-thread aria-label="Comments on issue 482">
  <article data-comment id="c1" data-author="Ada Lovelace" data-time="2026-05-14T10:00:00Z" data-mine>
    <div data-comment-body>Looks great — ship it.</div>
    <reaction-bar>
      <button data-reaction="thumbsup" data-count="3" data-mine>👍</button>
      <template data-palette>
        <button data-reaction="thumbsup">👍</button>
        <button data-reaction="heart">❤️</button>
        <button data-reaction="rocket">🚀</button>
      </template>
    </reaction-bar>
  </article>

  <article data-comment id="c2" data-author="Bob" data-time="2026-05-14T11:00:00Z" data-parent="c1">
    <div data-comment-body>Agreed!</div>
  </article>

  <template data-reply-form>
    <comment-box submit-label="Reply" data-show-cancel></comment-box>
  </template>
</comment-thread>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | string |  | Region label for the thread (default "Comments") |
| `data-disabled` | boolean |  | Read-only mode — no Reply / Edit / Delete actions |
| `role` |  |  | Set to "region" when absent |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-comment` | article | boolean |  | Marks an article as a thread comment |
| `data-author` | article | string |  | Display name |
| `data-author-href` | article | string |  | Optional link to the author's profile. Only http(s) and relative URLs become a link; anything else renders as text |
| `data-author-avatar` | article | string |  | Optional avatar URL (renders <user-avatar>) |
| `data-time` | article | string |  | ISO-8601 timestamp; rendered relative (Intl.RelativeTimeFormat in the element's lang) with the absolute time in title. Unparseable values render as-is |
| `data-mine` | article | boolean |  | Current user authored this comment — enables Edit / Delete |
| `data-parent` | article | string |  | Id of parent comment for nested replies |
| `data-edited` | article | string |  | ISO timestamp of last edit; renders "(edited)" badge |
| `data-comment-body` | * | boolean |  | Marks the comment body (any element, e.g. <section> or <div>) |
| `data-reply-form` | template | boolean |  | Marks the template whose content is cloned for the reply form |
| `aria-labelledby` | article | string |  | Set by the component: names each comment from its author and time |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `comment-thread:reply` | `{ parentId, value, waitUntil(promise) }` | Reply form submitted. Cancelable, same contract as comment-box:submit: do nothing and the form closes; waitUntil(promise) keeps it busy, closing on resolve and keeping the text on reject; preventDefault() during the handler keeps it open. Focus returns to the comment's Reply button when it closes. |
| `comment-thread:edit-request` | `{ commentId, value }` | Edit clicked; value is the body's text. Author renders an editor and calls updateComment |
| `comment-thread:delete-request` | `{ commentId }` | Delete clicked; author confirms + calls removeComment |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `addComment(data)` | Insert a comment: data { id, author, time, bodyText? \| bodyHtml?, parentId?, mine?, authorHref?, authorAvatar?, edited? }. bodyText is set as text; bodyHtml is sanitized. A reply goes after its parent's last descendant. Returns the <article> |
| `updateComment(id, patch)` | Patch a comment: patch { bodyText? \| bodyHtml?, author?, edited? } |
| `removeComment(id)` | Remove a comment from the thread |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Landmark region
- You provide: An <article data-comment> for each comment, and an aria-label on the thread when the default "Comments" does not describe it
- The component manages: `role="region"`, `role="group"`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Reply to, edit or delete the comment | Native behaviour of <button> |

# <compare-surface>

Before/after comparison slider: two overlaid children with a draggable, keyboard-operable divider (side by side without JS)

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/comparison/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<compare-surface>
  <img src="before.jpg" alt="Before" />
  <img src="after.jpg" alt="After" />
</compare-surface>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | number |  | Divider position 0-100 measured from the inline-start edge (right in RTL), default 50. Observed; user drags and key presses reflect the integer value back. |
| `label` | string |  | Accessible name for the slider handle, default "Comparison slider". Observed. |
| `aria-label` |  |  | Used as the slider handle's accessible name when label is absent. A host with aria-label or aria-labelledby and no role of its own gets role="group" |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `First child (any element)` | Shown on the inline-start side of the divider (the "before" view) |
| `Second child (any element)` | Shown on the inline-end side of the divider (the "after" view). Further children are hidden once upgraded. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `compare-surface:change` | `{ position: number }` | Fired when the user drags or uses the keyboard and the integer position changes. Not fired on upgrade or for attribute/property writes. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `number` | Get or set the integer position (0-100). Setting clamps, rounds and reflects to the attribute without firing compare-surface:change. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Slider
- You provide: Two child elements to compare, each with its own text alternative, and a label attribute when the default slider name does not fit
- The component manages: `role="slider"`, `role="group"`, `tabindex`, `aria-label`, `aria-orientation`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuetext`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrowRight` | Increase the position by 1% (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus on the divider |
| `ArrowLeft` | Decrease the position by 1% (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus on the divider |
| `ArrowUp` | Increase the position by 1% | Focus on the divider |
| `ArrowDown` | Decrease the position by 1% | Focus on the divider |
| `Shift+ArrowRight` / `Shift+ArrowLeft` / `Shift+ArrowUp` / `Shift+ArrowDown` | Change the position by 10% instead of 1% | Focus on the divider |
| `PageUp` | Increase the position by 10% | Focus on the divider |
| `PageDown` | Decrease the position by 10% | Focus on the divider |
| `Home` | Set the position to 0% | Focus on the divider |
| `End` | Set the position to 100% | Focus on the divider |

# <consent-banner>

Cookie consent banner with granular category controls and persistence

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/consent-banner/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<consent-banner>
  <dialog>
    <p>We use cookies to improve your experience.
      <a href="/privacy">Privacy Policy</a></p>
    <footer>
      <button value="reject">Reject All</button>
      <button value="accept">Accept All</button>
    </footer>
  </dialog>
</consent-banner>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `persist` | string | `banner` | VBStore key under namespace 'consent'. Stored in localStorage as vb:consent:<persist>. |
| `position` | `bottom`, `top`, `center` | `bottom` | Banner position. Center uses modal dialog. |
| `trigger` | string |  | CSS selector for a re-open button (e.g. #manage-cookies) |
| `expires` | string | `365` | Days until stored consent expires (banner and getConsent). 0 or 'never' disables expiry. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | button | `accept`, `reject`, `save` |  | Action button type — accept all, reject all, or save granular preferences |
| `name` | input[type=checkbox] | string |  | Preference category name; becomes a key in the stored and emitted preferences object |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<dialog>` | Banner container — shown until consent is given. Named from its first heading (aria-labelledby) or aria-label="Cookie consent" unless the author names it. |
| `<button value="accept">` | Accept-all action button |
| `<button value="reject">` | Reject-all action button (optional) |
| `<input type="checkbox">` | Granular preference toggles (optional, for save mode) |
| `<button value="save">` | Save granular preferences button (optional, used with checkboxes) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `consent-banner:change` | `{ preferences: Record<string, boolean>, action: 'accept' \| 'reject' \| 'save' }` | Fired when the user clicks an accept, reject, or save button. preferences maps checkbox names to booleans; action is the button's value. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ConsentBanner.getConsent(key?, options?)` | Static. Read stored consent for key (default 'banner'). Honours expiry: options.expires (days), else the expires attribute of an in-document banner with the same persist key, else 365. Resolves null when missing, expired, or storage is unavailable. |
| `ConsentBanner.reset(key?)` | Static. Clear stored consent for key (default 'banner') so the banner reappears on the next load. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native dialog
- You provide: A <dialog> containing a heading (used as its name) and buttons with value="accept", "reject" or "save"
- The component manages: `aria-labelledby`, `aria-label`, `hidden`

---

# <content-lens>

Universal switchable host for VB lens components; JS API: activeLens (read-only), setLens(name)

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/content-lens/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<content-lens data-lens-default="trust" data-lens-src="/pages.json">
  <time-index   data-lens-name="time">…</time-index>
  <author-index data-lens-name="author"></author-index>
  <topic-map    data-lens-name="topic"></topic-map>
  <trust-filter data-lens-name="trust"></trust-filter>
</content-lens>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-lens-default` | string |  | Lens name to show on first load |
| `data-lens-controls` | string |  | "on" (default) \| "off" — render reader controls |
| `data-lens-src` | string |  | Shared JSON source URL forwarded to lens children lacking their own data-lens-src/src (order-independent; already-upgraded children are re-initialised) |
| `data-lens-storage` | string |  | Key for sessionStorage persistence (default: pathname) |
| `data-active-lens` | string |  | Reflects the currently active lens |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-lens-name` | direct lens child | string |  | Registers the child as a switchable lens; value used by data-lens-default, setLens() and the event detail |
| `data-lens-label` | direct lens child | string |  | Chip text (default: humanised data-lens-name) |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Lens components, each with data-lens-name |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content-lens:change` | `{ lens: string }` | Fires when the reader or setLens() changes the active lens; not on the initial/restored selection |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `setLens(name)` | Switch to the named lens (ignored if unknown). Persists the choice; fires content-lens:change only when the lens actually changes. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `activeLens` | `string` | data-lens-name of the visible lens ('' before upgrade). |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native form controls
- You provide: A data-lens-label on each lens when its data-lens-name does not read well as a radio label
- The component manages: `hidden`

# <content-swap>

Two-face content toggle with accessible state management. The hidden face is made inert; with no [data-swap] triggers a real toggle button is generated (visually hidden until focused) and surface clicks swap for pointer users. Also available as the [data-swap] attribute form on any element with [data-face] children.

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/content-swap/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<content-swap transition="flip">
  <div data-face="front">
    <p>Front content visible by default.</p>
  </div>
  <div data-face="back">
    <p>Back content revealed on swap.</p>
  </div>
</content-swap>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transition` | `flip`, `flip-vertical`, `fade`, `slide-left`, `slide-up`, `scale` | `flip` | Transition effect between faces. The attribute form uses data-transition. |
| `swapped` | boolean |  | Showing the back face. Reflected by the runtime; may be set or removed by authors at any time and inert follows it. The attribute form uses data-swapped. |
| `card` | boolean |  | Apply layout-card visual shell (pair with data-variant: elevated, outlined, ghost) |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-face` | direct child | `front`, `back` |  | Marks the front and back faces |
| `data-swap` | button (any descendant) | boolean |  | Explicit swap trigger. When present, the surface is not clickable and no toggle is generated. |
| `data-swap-toggle` | button (direct child) | boolean |  | Toggle used when there are no data-swap triggers; generated with the text "Show back" if absent. Author one to set the label. Receives aria-pressed. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content-swap:swap` | `{ swapped: boolean, source: 'pointer' \| 'keyboard' \| 'api' }` | Fired after the faces swap; source is what caused it |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `flip()` | Show the back face |
| `unflip()` | Show the front face |
| `toggle()` | Toggle between faces |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `swapped` | `boolean` | Get or set whether the back face is showing |
| `flipped` | `boolean` | Alias for swapped |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Button
- You provide: Explicit [data-swap] triggers should be <button> elements with a text label (any other element is given role="button" and tabindex="0"); without triggers a "Show back" toggle button is generated
- The component manages: `inert`, `aria-pressed`, `role="button"`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Swap faces and move focus to the first control on the face now showing | Focus on a [data-swap] trigger (native behaviour of a button or link; handled by the component on other elements) |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Swap faces and keep focus on the toggle | Native behaviour of button (the generated or authored data-swap-toggle) |

---

# <context-menu>

Right-click (and Shift+F10 / ContextMenu key) menu with keyboard navigation and shortcut bindings

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/context-menu/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<context-menu>
  <p data-trigger>Right-click anywhere here</p>
  <menu>
    <li><button>Cut</button></li>
    <li><button>Copy</button></li>
    <li><button>Paste</button></li>
    <li role="separator"></li>
    <li><button class="danger">Delete</button></li>
  </menu>
</context-menu>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-open` | boolean |  | Reflected when context menu is visible. Uses data-open because the host is not a native dialog/details — open would be semantically misleading. |
| `data-label-available` | string | `Context menu available` | Description (aria-description) set on a trigger that is not a control, so screen readers announce that a menu exists. Not used when the trigger has its own aria-description or aria-describedby. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-trigger` | * | boolean |  | Element defining the right-click target area |
| `data-group` | li | boolean |  | Group label row. It and the items after it (up to the next label or separator) are wrapped in role="group" named by the label |
| `data-shortcut` | button, a | string |  | Keyboard shortcut bound page-wide (hotkey-bind, preventDefault) and shown as a badge, e.g. 'f2' or 'shift+d'. Never use clipboard combos. |
| `data-disabled` | button, a | boolean |  | Disabled item: aria-disabled="true", stays in the arrow-key order, cannot be activated |
| `data-value` | button, a | string |  | Value reported in context-menu:select detail.value and the items property |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `any element with data-trigger` | Right-click target area. Made focusable (tabindex="0") when it is not already. A control (button, link, or a focusable element with a widget role) gets aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls; any other trigger gets an aria-description instead. These are removed on disconnect |
| `<menu>` | Context menu with <li> items holding <button> or <a> actions; <li data-group> labels and <li role="separator"> rows |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context-menu:open` |  | Fired when the menu opens |
| `context-menu:close` |  | Fired when the menu closes |
| `context-menu:select` | `{ item, value }` | Fired when an item is activated by click, keyboard or its shortcut (not for disabled items) |
| `context-menu:items-changed` | `{ items, source: 'property' }` | Fired after the items property rebuilds the menu |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `close()` | Close the menu |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Array<{ label, value?, href?, shortcut?, disabled? } \| { group } \| { separator: true }>` | Get the menu as data, or assign to rebuild it |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` | Read-only. Whether the menu is open |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Menu
- You provide: A trigger element and a <menu> of buttons or links with text labels
- The component manages: `role="menu"`, `role="menuitem"`, `role="none"`, `role="separator"`, `role="group"`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-description`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-keyshortcuts`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-hidden`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ContextMenu` / `Shift+F10` | Open the menu at the trigger and focus the first item | Focus on the trigger or on anything inside it |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the next item, wrapping to the first |  |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the previous item, wrapping to the last |  |
| `Home` | Move to the first item |  |
| `End` | Move to the last item |  |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Activate the focused item and close the menu |  |
| `Tab` | Close the menu |  |
| `Escape` | Close the menu and return focus to the trigger | Native behaviour of popover |

# <data-table>

Enhanced HTML table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row expansion, and selection

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/data-table/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<data-table>
  <table data-filterable data-paginate="5">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th data-sort="string">Name</th>
        <th data-sort="number">Age</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr>
        <td>Alice Johnson</td>
        <td>32</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td>Bob Smith</td>
        <td>28</td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</data-table>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-label-no-results` | string | `No matching rows found` | Text for the visible empty state and the live-region announcement when the filter matches no rows. |
| `data-label-filter` | string | `Filter table rows` | Accessible name of the filter input. |
| `data-label-placeholder` | string | `Filter table...` | Placeholder of the filter input. |
| `data-label-pagination` | string | `Table pagination` | Accessible name of the pagination nav. |
| `data-label-prev` | string | `Previous` | Text of the previous-page button. |
| `data-label-next` | string | `Next` | Text of the next-page button. |
| `data-label-sorted` | string | `Sorted by {column}, {direction}` | Announcement after a sort. {column} is replaced by the header text and {direction} by the data-label-ascending or data-label-descending text. |
| `data-label-ascending` | string | `ascending` | Direction word used for {direction} in the sort announcement. |
| `data-label-descending` | string | `descending` | Direction word used for {direction} in the sort announcement. |
| `data-label-filtered-one` | string | `{count} of {total} row shown` | Announcement after filtering when Intl.PluralRules selects "one" for the total. {count} is replaced by the number of matching rows and {total} by the number of rows. Any category works: -two, -few, -many, -zero. |
| `data-label-filtered-other` | string | `{count} of {total} rows shown` | Announcement after filtering for the "other" category and the fallback for unset categories. {count} and {total} are replaced. |
| `data-label-all-one` | string | `All {total} row shown` | Announcement when the filter is cleared ("one" category). {total} is replaced by the number of rows; {count} holds the same number. |
| `data-label-all-other` | string | `All {total} rows shown` | Announcement when the filter is cleared ("other" category and fallback). {total} is replaced by the number of rows; {count} holds the same number. |
| `data-label-selected-one` | string | `{count} row selected` | Announcement after a selection change when Intl.PluralRules selects "one" for the count. {count} is replaced by the number of selected rows. Any category works: -two, -few, -many, -zero. |
| `data-label-selected-other` | string | `{count} rows selected` | Announcement after a selection change for the "other" category and the fallback for unset categories. {count} is replaced. |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-filterable` | table | boolean |  | Enable text search filtering (adds a search input above the table) |
| `data-paginate` | table | number |  | Enable pagination with N rows per page |
| `data-sort` | th | `string`, `number`, `date` |  | Enable sorting on this column with the specified comparator |
| `data-weight` | th | number |  | Column weight; multiplier applied to cell values for weighted-sum rollups |
| `data-rollup` | th | `sum`, `weighted-sum`, `product`, `avg`, `max` |  | Compute this column's cells from sibling cells in the same row |
| `data-heatmap` | th | `auto`, `low-good`, `high-good` |  | Tint this column's cells by relative value bucket (low/mid/high) |
| `data-sort-value` | td | string |  | Custom sort value overriding cell text. Use for formatted values, e.g. <td data-sort-value="1234">$1,234</td> — data-sort="number" parses the cell with parseFloat, so "$1,234" would sort as 0 |
| `data-filter-value` | td | string |  | Custom filter value overriding cell text |
| `data-expandable` | tr | boolean |  | Mark row as expandable (followed by a data-expand-content row). Supply the toggle yourself: <button data-action="toggle-expand"> in a cell; the component manages aria-expanded |
| `data-expand-content` | tr | boolean |  | Hidden row revealed when its preceding expandable row is toggled |
| `data-selectable` | tr | boolean |  | Mark row as selectable via an author-supplied <input type="checkbox" data-action="select-row">; a thead checkbox with data-action="select-all" toggles all |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<table>` | Standard HTML table — the component enhances it in place |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data-table:sort` | `{ column, direction, columnName }` | Fired when a column is sorted |
| `data-table:filter` | `{ query, count }` | Fired when filter text changes |
| `data-table:page` | `{ page }` | Fired when page changes |
| `data-table:expand` | `{ row, expanded }` | Fired when a row is expanded or collapsed |
| `data-table:selection` | `{ count, rows[] }` | Fired when row selection changes |
| `data-table:rows-changed` | `{ rows, added, moved, removed, source }` | Fired after each .rows assignment with keyed-diff stats (source: 'api') |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `goToPage(page)` | Navigate to a page (1-indexed, clamped). No-op without data-paginate. |
| `setFilter(query)` | Set the filter text programmatically (updates the search input) and announce the result count. |
| `refresh()` | Re-scan rows after DOM changes and re-apply rollups, heatmaps, filter, sort and pagination. |
| `getSelectedRows()` | Currently selected rows. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `Array<{ id, [columnKey]: value }>` | Row records. Seeded from <tr data-id> on upgrade; assigning runs a keyed diff that preserves <tr> nodes whose id persists. |
| `columns` | `Array<{ key, label, sort? }>` | Column spec derived from <thead> (th data-key, else lowercased header text). |
| `renderRow` | `(row, columns) => Element` | Optional custom row renderer used for new rows in .rows assignments. |
| `currentPage` | `number` | Current page (1-indexed). |
| `totalPages` | `number` | Total pages for the current filter (1 when not paginated). |
| `filteredCount` | `number` | Rows matching the current filter. |
| `totalCount` | `number` | Total data rows (expansion content rows excluded). |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Table
- You provide: A <table> with <th> headers, a caption or other accessible name, labelled row checkboxes and a labelled <button data-action="toggle-expand"> for expandable rows
- The component manages: `aria-sort`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-hidden`, `aria-current`, `aria-label`, `aria-live`, `aria-atomic`, `role="status"`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Sort by the column, toggling between ascending and descending | Native behaviour of button (the generated sort button in a header) |

---

# <date-picker>

Form-associated calendar date picker with combobox text entry

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/date-picker/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<form-field>
  <label for="event">Event date</label>
  <date-picker>
    <input type="date" id="event" name="event" value="2026-04-15">
  </date-picker>
</form-field>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | Form field name. A name on the inner input (the no-JS path) moves here on upgrade so exactly one value submits; the host's own name wins if both are set. |
| `disabled` | boolean |  | Disables the text input and calendar button, closes the calendar and drops the value from submission. A disabled ancestor fieldset has the same effect. A disabled on the inner input moves here on upgrade. |
| `required` | boolean |  | Makes a date required (valueMissing). Observed at runtime; a required on the inner input works too. |
| `data-disabled-dates` | string |  | Comma-separated ISO dates to disable (optionally with reason: "2026-04-05:booked"). Disabled days stay keyboard-focusable but cannot be selected. |
| `data-highlight-dates` | string |  | Comma-separated ISO dates to highlight (optionally with category: "2026-12-25:holiday"). Highlighted days remain selectable. |
| `data-label-toggle` | string | `Toggle calendar` | Accessible name for the calendar icon button (default "Toggle calendar"). |
| `data-label-dialog` | string | `Choose date` | Accessible name for the calendar popup (default "Choose date"). |
| `data-label-prev` | string | `Previous month` | Accessible name for the previous-month button (default "Previous month"). |
| `data-label-next` | string | `Next month` | Accessible name for the next-month button (default "Next month"). |
| `data-label-year` | string | `Year` | Accessible name for the year select (default "Year"). |
| `data-label-placeholder` | string | `Type a date…` | Placeholder for the text input (default "Type a date…"). |
| `data-label-required` | string | `Please select a date` | Validation message when required and empty (default "Please select a date"). |
| `data-label-range-underflow` | string | `Choose a date on or after {date}` | Validation message when the value is before min; {date} is replaced by the formatted min. A data-message-rangeunderflow on the inner input wins. |
| `data-label-range-overflow` | string | `Choose a date on or before {date}` | Validation message when the value is after max; {date} is replaced by the formatted max. A data-message-rangeoverflow on the inner input wins. |
| `data-label-input` | string | `Date` | Accessible name for the text input when neither a <label> nor an aria-label/aria-labelledby is present (default "Date"). |
| `open` | boolean |  | Reflected while the calendar is open |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | input | string |  | Initial date (ISO). The value attribute is the form-reset target. |
| `min` | input | string |  | Earliest selectable date (ISO) |
| `max` | input | string |  | Latest selectable date (ISO) |
| `name` | input | string |  | Submission name for the no-JS fallback. Moved to the host on upgrade. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<input type="date">` | Required. Supplies value/min/max and is the no-JS fallback. Its <label for> (or a <label for> on the host, or an aria-label) names the generated combobox. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date-picker:change` | `{ value, date, source: 'pointer' \| 'keyboard' \| 'api' }` | Fired when the selected date changes (not on form reset/restore). value is the ISO string ('' when cleared), date a Date or null. source is 'api' for .value assignments, 'pointer' for grid clicks, 'keyboard' for grid Enter/Space and typed commits. |
| `date-picker:open` |  | Fired when the calendar opens |
| `date-picker:close` |  | Fired when the calendar closes |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `checkValidity()` | Run constraint validation without showing UI |
| `reportValidity()` | Run constraint validation and show the browser message, anchored on the text input |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | Get or set the selected date as an ISO string (YYYY-MM-DD). Assigning '' or null clears; malformed or impossible dates (2026-02-31) are ignored. |
| `min` | `string` | Get or set the earliest selectable date (ISO). Updates the calendar and validity immediately; a current value before it is kept and flagged rangeUnderflow. |
| `max` | `string` | Get or set the latest selectable date (ISO). Updates the calendar and validity immediately; a current value after it is kept and flagged rangeOverflow. |
| `form` | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The associated form |
| `validity` | `ValidityState` | Current validity, owned by the host: valueMissing (required and empty), rangeUnderflow (before min), rangeOverflow (after max). Anchored on the text input. |
| `validationMessage` | `string` | Current validation message |
| `willValidate` | `boolean` | Whether the element is a candidate for constraint validation |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Combobox
- You provide: An <input type="date"> with a <label for> (or an aria-label); the label is passed to the generated combobox
- The component manages: `role="combobox"`, `role="dialog"`, `role="grid"`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-modal`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-selected`, `aria-current`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-required`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-hidden`, `aria-live`, `aria-atomic`, `tabindex`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrowDown` | Open the calendar and focus the selected or current day | Focus on the text input |
| `Enter` | Commit the typed date, or clear the value when the input is empty | Focus on the text input |
| `Escape` | Close the calendar and restore the displayed value | Focus on the text input |
| `Tab` | Close the calendar and move on | Focus on the text input |
| `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` | Move through the previous month button, the year select, the next month button and the day grid, wrapping within the calendar | Focus in the calendar |
| `ArrowRight` | Move to the next day (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the day grid |
| `ArrowLeft` | Move to the previous day (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the day grid |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the same weekday in the next week | Focus in the day grid |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the same weekday in the previous week | Focus in the day grid |
| `Home` | Move to the first day of the week | Focus in the day grid |
| `End` | Move to the last day of the week | Focus in the day grid |
| `PageDown` | Move to the same day in the next month | Focus in the day grid |
| `PageUp` | Move to the same day in the previous month | Focus in the day grid |
| `Shift+PageDown` | Move to the same day in the next year | Focus in the day grid |
| `Shift+PageUp` | Move to the same day in the previous year | Focus in the day grid |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Select the focused day, close the calendar and return focus to the text input | Focus in the day grid |
| `Escape` | Close the calendar and return focus to the text input | Focus in the calendar |

# <day-view>

Hour-grid schedule for a single day, using hour-view and calendar-event children

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/day-view/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<day-view data-date="2026-04-10">
  <ol>
    <li>
      <time datetime="09:00">9 AM</time>
      <hour-view>
        <calendar-event data-category="meeting">
          <time datetime="09:00">9:00</time>
          <icon-wc name="users" size="sm"></icon-wc>
          Sprint standup
        </calendar-event>
      </hour-view>
    </li>
    <li>
      <time datetime="10:00">10 AM</time>
      <hour-view>
        <calendar-event data-category="meeting" data-duration="2h">
          <time datetime="10:00">10:00</time>
          Design review
        </calendar-event>
      </hour-view>
    </li>
    <li>
      <time datetime="11:00">11 AM</time>
      <hour-view></hour-view>
    </li>
  </ol>
</day-view>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-date` | string |  | ISO date for this day view (e.g., 2026-04-10). Names the hour list (aria-label) and is passed as detail.date in day-view:event-click. |
| `data-start-hour` | string | `7` | First hour (0-23) of the grid the component generates when there is no authored <ol>, or 'auto' for a sparse range (first event hour - 1 to last event hour + 1). The range grows to fit events outside it. Ignored when you author the <ol>. |
| `data-end-hour` | number | `19` | Last hour (0-23) of the generated grid. Ignored when data-start-hour is 'auto' or the <ol> is authored. |
| `data-compact` | boolean |  | Compact presentation for dialog or overlay embedding |
| `data-label-continues` | string | `continues after the visible hours` | Text appended to the accessible name of a spanning event that runs past the last visible hour (localisation hook). |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-duration` | calendar-event | string |  | Makes the event span hour rows. Durations (data-duration): 2h, 1.5h, 45m, 90m, 1h30m, bare minutes (60), ISO-8601 (PT1H30M); unparseable values fall back to 1 hour. Overlapping spans are laid out side by side. |
| `data-start` | calendar-event | `30` |  | Minute offset within the hour row; set automatically in generated grids for :30+ start times. |
| `data-continues` | calendar-event | boolean |  | Set by the component (not authored) on a spanning event clipped at the last visible hour; styled with a dashed end edge. |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ol` | Ordered list of hour slots |
| `li` | Single hour slot containing time label + hour-view |
| `time` | Hour label with datetime='HH:00' |
| `hour-view` | Container for calendar-event elements within the hour |
| `calendar-event` | Individual event with time, category, and optional duration |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `day-view:event-click` | `{ date, time, text, element, category, duration }` | Fired when a calendar-event is clicked, or activated with Enter/Space while focused |
| `day-view:events-changed` | `{ events, source: 'property' }` | Fired after the events property rebuilds the view |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `refresh()` | Re-measure and re-position spanning events now (they also re-position automatically when the view resizes) |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `events` | `Array<{ time?, text, category?, duration?, href? }>` | Get the day's events as data, or assign an array to rebuild the view (sets data-start-hour="auto"). time is HH:MM or a full ISO datetime (wall-clock as written); omit it for an all-day event. Durations (data-duration): 2h, 1.5h, 45m, 90m, 1h30m, bare minutes (60), ISO-8601 (PT1H30M); unparseable values fall back to 1 hour. |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Native list with roving tabindex
- You provide: Each <calendar-event> needs a <time datetime> and a text title, from which its label is built
- The component manages: `role="button"`, `role="group"`, `aria-label`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the next event |  |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the previous event |  |
| `Home` | Move to the first event |  |
| `End` | Move to the last event |  |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Fire day-view:event-click for the focused event | Focus on the event itself, not a link or button inside it |

# <diagram-wc>

Declarative diagram renderer — wraps Mermaid (v1) with VB token-driven theming, lazy load, and HTML-first authoring via fenced code blocks

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/diagram-wc/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<diagram-wc type="mermaid" caption="Login flow">
  <pre><code class="language-mermaid">flowchart LR
    accTitle: Login flow
    accDescr: Valid credentials create a session; invalid ones return to the visit step.
    A[Visit] --> B{Valid creds?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Session]
    B -->|No| A
  </code></pre>
</diagram-wc>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string |  | Backend selector. v1 only supports "mermaid" |
| `src` | string |  | URL of a diagram source file (.mmd). Takes priority over inline <pre><code> source; fetched once per URL (not refetched when the element is moved). |
| `caption` | string |  | Rendered as <figcaption> below the SVG |
| `loading` | string |  | "lazy" defers render until the element scrolls into view |
| `data-theme-base` | string |  | Mermaid base theme: base\|default\|dark\|forest\|neutral. Default "base" so VB tokens win. |
| `min-height` | string |  | CSS length reserved for the diagram before render to prevent layout shift |
| `data-label-error` | string | `Diagram syntax error: {message}` | Text of the error note, also announced to screen readers; {message} is the first line of the parser error. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `diagram-wc:ready` | `{ svg: string, type: string, source: string }` | After a successful render (initial, source change or theme re-render) |
| `diagram-wc:error` | `{ error: Error, source: string\|null, type: string }` | Render or src fetch failed. If nothing has rendered yet the <pre> source is shown with an error note; otherwise the prior figure stays visible |
| `diagram-wc:source-changed` | `{ source: string }` | The .source setter assigned a new value |
| `diagram-wc:upgraded` |  | Fired once after the component upgrades |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `string` | Get/set the diagram source. Setting it re-renders (the prior figure stays until the new one is ready, and on a parse error) and fires diagram-wc:source-changed. Kept across disconnect/reconnect. |
| `svg` | `string` | Serialized markup of the currently rendered SVG, or an empty string before the first render |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Figure with labelled SVG
- You provide: A caption attribute, or accTitle and accDescr lines in the Mermaid source, to name and describe the diagram
- The component manages: `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`

```html
  for presentation.</dd>

  <dt>JavaScript</dt>
  <dd>A programming language that enables interactive
  web pages.</dd>
</dl>
```

```html
    <dd>Alexandra Chen</dd>
  </dl-item>

    <dt>Email</dt>
    <dd>alexandra.chen@example.com</dd>
  </dl-item>
  <dl-item>
    <dt>Role</dt>
    <dd>Senior Engineer</dd>
  </dl-item>
  <dl-item>
    <dt>Status</dt>
    <dd>Active</dd>
  </dl-item>
</dl>
```

# <drag-surface>

Accessible drag-and-drop reorder surface with keyboard reorder, optional single-pointer move controls, live announcements and cross-surface transfer

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/drag-surface/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<drag-surface data-layout="stack" data-layout-gap="xs">
  <article class="card" draggable="true" data-id="task-1">Design review</article>
  <article class="card" draggable="true" data-id="task-2">Code audit</article>
  <article class="card" draggable="true" data-id="task-3">Deploy staging</article>
</drag-surface>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | string |  | Transfer group; items move between surfaces sharing a group |
| `orientation` | `vertical`, `horizontal` | `vertical` | "horizontal" switches keyboard reorder to Left/Right and drop maths to the inline axis; both follow the computed direction (RTL-aware) |
| `disabled` | boolean |  | Disables dragging out, dropping in, keyboard reorder and move controls; reflected as aria-disabled and skipped as a transfer target |
| `data-move-controls` | boolean |  | Renders per-item Move buttons (up/down or inline start/end, plus Move to <adjacent surface> for grouped surfaces) — the single-pointer alternative to dragging (WCAG 2.5.7) |
| `data-label-instructions` | string | `Press Space or Enter to grab, then use the arrow keys to move` | Description set on each item (aria-description) that tells screen reader users how to move it |
| `role` |  |  | Managed: always "list" |
| `aria-disabled` | string |  | Managed: "true" while disabled is present |
| `data-drag-over` | boolean |  | Present while a dragged item from an accepted source hovers the surface |
| `data-reorder-mode` | boolean |  | Present while one of the surface's items is grabbed for keyboard reorder |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `draggable` | direct child | `true` |  | Native attribute; marks a direct child as a reorderable item (gets role=listitem, tabindex=0 and an aria-description with the move instructions, including items added later) |
| `data-id` | direct child | string |  | Stable identifier reported in event details and sortedOrder |
| `data-sort-order` | direct child | number |  | 1-based position, rewritten by the component after each move |
| `data-drag-handle` | descendant of an item | boolean |  | Only this element starts a pointer drag; a focusable button handle also accepts reorder keys and gets aria-pressed while grabbed |
| `data-grabbed` | direct child | boolean |  | Output: present while the item is grabbed for keyboard reorder (aria-description changes to "Grabbed" unless the item has its own description) |
| `data-dragging` | direct child | boolean |  | Output: present on the item during a pointer drag |
| `data-drop-target` | direct child | `before`, `after` |  | Output: insertion indicator during a pointer drag (drawn on the block or inline edge, RTL-aware) |
| `data-just-dropped` | direct child | boolean |  | Output: briefly present after a drop or move to trigger the flash animation |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `drag-surface:reorder-start` |  | A pointer drag or keyboard grab began |
| `drag-surface:reorder` | `{ item: HTMLElement, itemId: string \| undefined, oldIndex: number, newIndex: number, order: (string \| undefined)[] }` | Items within this surface were reordered (pointer drag, keyboard drop or move control) |
| `drag-surface:transfer` | `{ item: HTMLElement, itemId: string \| undefined, fromSurface: DragSurface, toSurface: DragSurface, newIndex: number, fromOrder: (string \| undefined)[], toOrder: (string \| undefined)[] }` | An item moved to another surface in the same group; fired on the receiving surface |
| `drag-surface:reorder-end` |  | A pointer drag or keyboard grab ended (dropped, cancelled or abandoned); for pointer drags it fires on the source surface |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sortedOrder` | `(string \| undefined)[]` | data-id of each draggable child in DOM order |
| `draggableChildren` | `HTMLElement[]` | Direct children with draggable="true" (a new array on each read) |
| `group` | `string \| null` | The group attribute, or null |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | Normalised orientation attribute |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Reflects the disabled attribute |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Sortable list
- You provide: An aria-label on the surface (used in announcements) and readable text or an aria-label in each draggable item. Every item is a tab stop and is described with how to move it
- The component manages: `role="list"`, `role="listitem"`, `role="status"`, `tabindex`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-pressed`, `aria-description`, `aria-label`, `aria-live`, `aria-atomic`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Grab the item, or drop it when already grabbed | Focus on an item or its drag handle |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` | Move focus to the next or previous item, or move the grabbed item one position | Vertical orientation |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft` | Move focus to the next or previous item, or move the grabbed item one position (reversed in right-to-left) | Horizontal orientation |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft` | Move the grabbed item to the next or previous surface in the group | Vertical orientation, item grabbed |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` | Move the grabbed item to the next or previous surface in the group | Horizontal orientation, item grabbed |
| `Escape` | Cancel the grab and return the item to where it started, or blur the item when nothing is grabbed |  |

---

# <drop-down>

Accessible dropdown: an APG menu button for actions, or (with hover) an APG disclosure for navigation links

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/dropdown/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<drop-down>
  <button data-trigger>Options</button>
  <menu>
    <li><button>Edit</button></li>
    <li><button>Duplicate</button></li>
    <li><button>Share</button></li>
    <li role="separator"></li>
    <li><button class="danger">Delete</button></li>
  </menu>
</drop-down>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `bottom-start`, `bottom-end`, `top-start`, `top-end` | `bottom-start` | Menu position relative to the trigger. start/end are logical, so they mirror in RTL |
| `hover` | boolean |  | Navigation disclosure: no menu roles, links stay in the Tab order, a <button aria-expanded> toggles the list (generated next to a link trigger). Opens on mouse hover or toggle activation, not on focus |
| `no-flip` | boolean |  | Keep the requested position instead of flipping to the opposite side when the menu overflows the viewport |
| `open` | boolean |  | Reflected state — set by open()/close()/toggle() methods, not intended as initial markup |

## Attributes on children

| Attribute | On | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-trigger` | button \| a | boolean |  | Marks the element that opens the menu. Falls back to the first direct <button> if absent. |
| `data-disabled` | button, a | boolean |  | Disabled item: aria-disabled="true", stays in the arrow-key order, cannot be activated |
| `data-value` | button, a | string |  | Value reported in drop-down:select detail.value and the items property |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<button data-trigger> or <a data-trigger>` | Trigger element that opens the menu. Action mode: aria-haspopup="menu" + aria-expanded. Navigation mode: a link trigger stays a plain link |
| `<button data-dropdown-toggle>` | Navigation mode with a link trigger: the submenu toggle (aria-expanded, aria-controls). Generated with aria-label "<link text> submenu" when absent; author one to set your own label |
| `<menu>` | Menu container with <li> items holding <button> or <a> actions. Only rows whose nearest menu is this one belong to it (nested drop-downs keep their own) |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `drop-down:open` |  | Fired when the menu opens |
| `drop-down:close` |  | Fired when the menu closes |
| `drop-down:select` | `{ item, value }` | Fired when one of this menu's items is activated by click or keyboard (not for disabled items or a nested drop-down's trigger row) |
| `drop-down:items-changed` | `{ items, source: 'property' }` | Fired after the items property rebuilds the menu |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open()` | Open the menu |
| `close()` | Close the menu |
| `toggle()` | Toggle the menu |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Array<{ label, value?, href?, disabled? } \| { separator: true }>` | Get the menu as data, or assign to rebuild it (href → <a>, otherwise <button type="button">; disabled → data-disabled + aria-disabled) |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` | Read-only. Whether the menu is open |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Menu button
- You provide: A trigger with a text label and a <menu> of buttons or links; in hover (navigation) mode the list keeps link semantics and a toggle button is generated beside a link trigger
- The component manages: `role="menu"`, `role="menuitem"`, `role="none"`, `role="separator"`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-label`, `tabindex`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Open the menu and focus the first item | Native behaviour of button (the trigger) |
| `ArrowDown` | Open the menu and focus the first item | Focus on the trigger, action mode |
| `ArrowUp` | Open the menu and focus the last item | Focus on the trigger, action mode |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the next item, wrapping to the first | Focus in the menu, action mode |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the previous item, wrapping to the last | Focus in the menu, action mode |
| `Home` | Move to the first item | Focus in the menu, action mode |
| `End` | Move to the last item | Focus in the menu, action mode |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Activate the focused item and close the menu | Focus in the menu, action mode |
| `Printable character` | Move to the next item whose label starts with the typed characters | Focus in the menu, action mode |
| `Tab` | Close the menu | Focus in the menu, action mode |
| `Escape` | Close the menu and return focus to the trigger or toggle button |  |

---

# <emoji-picker>

Accessible emoji picker with search, a category toolbar, a listbox of emoji, and undoable insertion into a target field

- Web component. Needs the Vanilla Breeze script; its children are the fallback when script has not run.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/web-components/emoji-picker/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<label for="msg">Message</label>
<textarea id="msg" rows="3"></textarea>
<emoji-picker for="msg">
  <button data-trigger type="button" aria-label="Insert emoji">😀</button>
</emoji-picker>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `for` | string |  | ID of the input, textarea or contenteditable the emoji is inserted into (at the saved caret, as an undoable edit that fires an insertText input event). Omit to handle emoji-picker:select yourself. |
| `recent-limit` | number | `24` | Maximum number of recently used emoji kept in localStorage (vb-emoji-recent) |
| `data-trigger` | boolean |  | Marks the trigger button (a direct child). Without one the first child <button> is used, else a trigger is created. Hidden until the element is defined (no-JS). |
| `data-label-trigger` | string | `Open emoji picker` | Trigger accessible name, applied only when the trigger has no text and no aria-label |
| `data-label-dialog` | string | `Emoji picker` | Accessible name of the picker panel |
| `data-label-search` | string | `Search emoji` | Accessible name of the search input |
| `data-label-placeholder` | string | `Search emoji…` | Search input placeholder |
| `data-label-categories` | string | `Emoji categories` | Accessible name of the category toolbar |
| `data-label-emoji` | string | `Emoji` | Accessible name of the emoji listbox |
| `data-label-recent` | string | `Recently used` | Name of the recently used group |
| `data-label-empty` | string | `No emoji found` | Empty search message (shown and announced) |
| `data-label-results` | string | `{count} emoji found` | Result-count announcement; {count} is replaced |
| `data-label-smileys` | string | `Smileys & Emotion` | Category name for smileys |
| `data-label-people` | string | `People & Body` | Category name for people |
| `data-label-animals` | string | `Animals & Nature` | Category name for animals |
| `data-label-food` | string | `Food & Drink` | Category name for food |
| `data-label-travel` | string | `Travel & Places` | Category name for travel |
| `data-label-activities` | string | `Activities` | Category name for activities |
| `data-label-objects` | string | `Objects` | Category name for objects |
| `data-label-symbols` | string | `Symbols` | Category name for symbols |
| `data-label-flags` | string | `Flags` | Category name for flags |
| `open` | boolean |  | Reflected state — set by open()/close()/toggle(), not intended as initial markup |

## Structure

| Child | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<button data-trigger>` | Optional trigger. An emoji-only trigger needs an aria-label. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `emoji-picker:select` | `{ shortcode, emoji, name, keywords }` | Fired when an emoji is selected, after it was inserted into the for target |
| `emoji-picker:open` |  | Fired when the picker opens |
| `emoji-picker:close` |  | Fired when the picker closes |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `open()` | Open the panel and focus the search input. Queued until the panel is built |
| `close()` | Close the panel (focus is not moved). Before the build it cancels a queued open |
| `toggle()` | Open when closed, close when open. Queued until the panel is built |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` | Read-only. Whether the panel is open |
| `ready` | `Promise<void>` | Read-only. Resolves once the panel is built (emoji data loads asynchronously); data-upgraded is set at the same time |

## Accessibility

- Pattern: Non-modal dialog with a listbox
- You provide: A <button data-trigger> with a text label or aria-label (a default name is added when it has no letters)
- The component manages: `role="dialog"`, `role="toolbar"`, `role="listbox"`, `role="group"`, `role="option"`, `role="status"`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-label`, `aria-current`, `aria-selected`, `aria-hidden`, `tabindex`, `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter` / `Space` | Open the picker and focus the search field, or close it | Native behaviour of button (the trigger) |
| `Escape` | Close the picker and return focus to the trigger |  |
| `ArrowDown` | Move focus to the active or first emoji | Focus on the search field |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft` | Move to the next or previous category, wrapping (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the category toolbar |
| `Home` / `End` | Move to the first or last category | Focus in the category toolbar |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft` | Move to the next or previous emoji (reversed in right-to-left) | Focus in the emoji grid |
| `ArrowDown` | Move to the nearest emoji in the row below | Focus in the emoji grid |
| `ArrowUp` | Move to the nearest emoji in the row above, or to the search field from the first row | Focus in the emoji grid |
| `Home` / `End` | Move to the first or last visible emoji | Focus in the emoji grid |
| `PageDown` | Move to the first emoji of the next group | Focus in the emoji grid |
| `PageUp` | Move to the first emoji of the current group, then of the previous group | Focus in the emoji grid |
